· **Stock Reconciliation:** Reconcile physical stock counts with system inventory (ERP) to identify and investigate variances (daily/weekly/monthly).

· **Movement Tracking:** Record transfers of goods between the warehouse and the showroom.

**3\. Financial Reporting \& Compliance**

· **Month\-End Closing:** Prepare monthly profit \& loss (P\&L) statements, balance sheets, and MIS reports.

· **Taxation:** Handle GST return filings (GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B), TDS, TCS, and E\-invoicing compliance.

title: People Operations Lead (Talent & Org Systems)
description:
**Location:** Bangalore **Experience:** 2\-5 years **Type:** Full\-time \| On\-site **Start:** Immediate

**Why this role exists**

Most companies think HR is about policies.It isn’t.

It’s about building a system where **great people join, stay, perform, and scale**.

We are at a stage where hiring, performance, and culture cannot depend on founders anymore.This role exists to build a **repeatable, investor\-grade people engine**.

**What you’ll do**

You will not “manage HR.”You will **design and run the operating system for people.**

**1\. Build a high\-performance hiring engine**

* Own hiring across functions (engineering, GTM, ops)
* Design structured hiring processes (scorecards, interview loops, decision frameworks)
* Ensure quality of hire improves over time, not just speed
* Build pipelines for leadership hiring (not just execution roles)

**2\. Design compensation \& ownership frameworks**

* Build clear, defensible **compensation bands**
* Create an **ESOP framework** aligned with long\-term value creation
* Ensure all comp decisions can withstand **Series A investor scrutiny**

**3\. Create a world\-class onboarding system**

* Design onboarding that drives **productivity in weeks, not months**
* Standardize onboarding playbooks across roles
* Track onboarding success through measurable outcomes

**4\. Own performance management**

* Design and run performance review cycles
* Create clarity on:
* What good looks like
* How performance is measured
* How decisions are made (promotions, exits, rewards)
* Enable managers to run high\-quality performance conversations

**5\. Build team health \& operating rhythm**

* Own:
* Leave management
* Team well\-being
* Feedback loops
* Identify early signals of:
* Burnout
* Misalignment
* Performance drift
* Intervene before problems become visible

**6\. Develop leadership pipeline**

* Identify and hire future leaders
* Work with founders to define leadership expectations
* Build succession depth across teams

**7\. Create an intern\-to\-full\-time talent engine**

* Design structured intern programs
* Train interns into deployable talent
* Build a **bench of pre\-trained candidates** ready for rapid hiring

**What success looks like**

* Hiring becomes **predictable, high\-quality, and fast**
* New hires become productive within **weeks**
* Compensation and ESOP structures are **clear and defensible**
* Performance reviews are **objective and trusted**
* Team health issues are **caught early and resolved**
* There is always a **ready talent pipeline (interns \+ leadership)**

**Who you are**

* You have **2\-5 years of experience in people operations / talent**
* You have built or scaled **hiring and people systems**, not just executed processes
* You think in **systems and frameworks**, not policies
* You are comfortable working closely with founders and influencing decisions
* You care deeply about **performance, not just culture optics**

**What will make you stand out**

* Experience in high\-growth startups (Series A/B stage)
* Designed comp/ESOP frameworks from scratch
* Built structured hiring and performance systems
* Worked on leadership hiring and org design
* Can combine **data \+ judgment** in people decisions

**Why join**

* You will build the **people foundation of a scaling company**
* Your work directly impacts **team quality, speed, and culture**
* You will operate close to leadership and influence core decisions

**What this role is not**

* Not an admin or policy management role
* Not limited to payroll, compliance, or coordination
* Not reactive HR support

**What this role is**

* A **builder of systems**
* A **guardian of talent quality**
* A **multiplier of team performance**

title: Area HR Partner (North & East)
description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
  
**Your mission**
----------------


Reports to: Senior Manager HR (Retail North \& East)


Position Summary: The Retail HR role partners closely with retail operations to support people\-related initiatives across stores. The role focuses on driving hiring, employee engagement, capability development, and compliance while building a strong connect with store teams and supporting the overall employee experience in the region.


Key Objectives:

* Manage the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle for retail employees including recruitment, onboarding, engagement initiatives, training and development, and exit interviews.
* Drive hiring across retail stores by identifying and leveraging both internal and external recruitment sources to ensure timely closure of open positions.
* Partner with retail operations stakeholders and store managers to understand manpower requirements and support people\-related decisions across stores.
* Assess behavioral and capability development needs of store employees and coordinate relevant training programs with internal or external trainers.
* Plan and manage the monthly employee engagement calendar across stores to strengthen employee connect and morale.
* Coordinate and ensure timely and accurate submission of payroll inputs for retail employees.
* Conduct regular store visits to interact with employees, gather feedback, understand on\-ground challenges, and support resolution of employee concerns.
* Track attrition trends and employee feedback across stores and work with business leaders to drive retention and employee experience initiatives.
* Ensure effective implementation of company policies across stores and monitor compliance with statutory requirements, including maintenance of statutory registers and documentation.
* Actively participate in various company forums and people initiatives within the organization.


**Your talent**
---------------


Eligibility Criteria And Functional Competencies Required:

* MBA / PGDM students specializing in HR or related fields.
* 2–4 years of HR experience, preferably in retail, hospitality, or other customer\-facing industries.
* Prior experience in managing store hiring, employee engagement, and HR operations will be an advantage.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and work with multiple stakeholders.


**Our principles**
------------------


PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.


At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.


PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Role Purpose**


The Engineering Manager (EM) is the single point of accountability for people leadership, delivery outcomes, and engineering practices across 2–3 Scrum teams within an Encompass release train. The EM provides direct people leadership for Encompass engineers, day\-to\-day work management and structured feedback for partner/other\-org developers, and drives adoption of AI\-native engineering practices across Development, Test, Release, Deployment \& Documentation, and AI Adoption in Engineering. Each EM also acts as Primary Practice Lead for one of these practices, running the relevant practice cohort (community of practice) and ensuring consistent, high\-quality, AI\-enabled ways of working that align with Encompass Engineering’s strategy and Engineering Culture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. People Leadership \& Staff Management**

* Act as people manager for approximately 15–20 engineers across 2–3 Scrum teams, owning hiring, onboarding, performance management, compensation input, and promotion recommendations.
* Set clear expectations and goals; provide regular coaching, feedback, and career development support for Encompass engineers.
* Conduct end\-of\-PI and quarterly reviews and annual performance appraisals in line with CSG processes.
* Provide structured work and performance feedback for partner/other\-org developers into their home line managers.
* Foster a healthy, inclusive culture in a predominantly remote, globally distributed environment, promoting psychological safety, collaboration, and constructive feedback.

**2\. Delivery Responsibility (2–3 Scrum Teams per ART)**

* Be accountable for delivery outcomes across 2–3 Scrum teams within a release train, including predictability against PI and iteration objectives, sustainable throughput, and quality.
* Partner with Technical Leads and Scrum teams to ensure PI and sprint plans are realistic, achievable, and aligned to team capacity and skills.
* Ensure teams are adhering to Encompass Engineering’s Engineering Culture and agreed practices across development, testing, release, documentation, and AI.
* Review and confirm teams’ PI and iteration plans and commitments before sign\-off.
* Monitor, track, and manage teams’ progress, risks, and issues, escalating and removing impediments requiring leadership action.

**3\. Engineering Practices \& Practice Leadership**

* Own and continuously improve engineering practices and standards across the four core practices: Development, Test, Release, Deployment \& Documentation, and AI Adoption in Engineering.
* Serve as Primary Practice Lead for one practice (and potentially Secondary Lead for another), running the relevant practice cohort/community of practice.
* Translate Strategic Architect and System Architect vision and guardrails into practical standards, templates, and playbooks usable by teams.
* Plan practice\-related work and capacity (frameworks, tools, training, documentation, AI patterns) and work with RTE/Scrum Masters to secure and visualise that capacity in PI and sprint plans.
* Track practice health metrics (e.g., automation coverage, documentation completeness, CI/CD health, AI usage and impact, change failure rate) and drive targeted improvements.

**4\. AI\-First Engineering Ways of Working**

* Promote responsible, human\-in\-the\-loop use of AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Glean, AI\-assisted test frameworks) for coding, testing, analysis, and documentation.
* Ensure AI usage adheres to security, privacy, compliance, and quality guardrails defined by the Strategic Architect Group.
* Embed AI\-assisted workflows into daily engineering practices (development, testing, debugging, documentation) to improve productivity and quality.
* Measure the impact of AI on productivity and quality and refine patterns, prompts, and training based on data and feedback.

**5\. Team Composition, Capability \& Collaboration**

* Shape team composition across 2–3 Scrum teams to optimise skills, experience, domain knowledge, growth opportunities, and resilience to attrition.
* Ensure effective Scrum Masters (in the Product Group) and Technical Leads are in place and operating to expectation.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, RTE/ART leadership, Architecture, HR, Talent and Finance on backlog prioritisation, capacity planning, workforce planning, and people programs.
* Support and participate in communities of practice (developers, testers, AI, etc.) and organisation\-wide initiatives across Bangalore and globally.

* **Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* **Experience**
* 8\+ years in software engineering roles (Developer, SDET, or similar).
* 3\+ years in a people\-leadership role (Engineering Manager, Team Lead, or equivalent), ideally leading multiple Agile teams.
* Demonstrated success delivering outcomes across multiple Scrum teams in an Agile/SAFe environment.
* Proven experience implementing and improving engineering practices (coding standards, testing, CI/CD, documentation).
* Experience managing risks and issues in complex, distributed programs and leading and developing engineers across locations.
* **Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong understanding of Agile/SAFe (Scrum, PI planning, ARTs, RTE, SM, PO roles).
* Ability to lead and inspire remote, cross\-functional engineering teams based in Bangalore and globally.
* Strong partnership skills with Product, Architecture, Agile/Program leadership, HR, and other stakeholders.

* Interest and aptitude in AI\-assisted engineering tools and concepts, with a willingness to learn and adopt new capabilities.

Cimpress Technology develops cutting\-edge, best\-in\-world software that our mass customization businesses use to create personalized products for millions of global customers. This makes it easier and faster to do things like introduce new products, reach customers and track orders. And this kind of innovation keeps customers coming back. Just last year, Cimpress generated $3\.2B in revenue through customized print products, signage, apparel, packaging and more.


**Our Team :**



The Cimpress Operations Specialist team will be established to support the end\-to\-end operational lifecycle across Cimpress businesses, ensuring seamless execution across product, fulfillment, manufacturing, and logistics operations in alignment with Cimpress platform standards.



This team will act as an extension of Cimpress operational and platform resources within Cimpress Technology and the individual Cimpress businesses, driving operational excellence across the full business lifecycle from configuration to production and fulfillment migration.

* Standards \& Operations Curator – Responsible for creating, updating, and governing operational standards and workflows across Cimpress businesses

To be effective in this role, team members must develop a strong understanding of individual business operations, fulfillment flows, manufacturing processes, and the Cimpress platform standards that govern them.


**Responsibilities :**


* Proactively develop deep knowledge of Cimpress standards, business operations, fulfillment flows, and manufacturing processes

Led by founder and CEO Robert Keane, Cimpress invests in and helps build customer\-focused, entrepreneurial mass customization businesses. Our businesses can choose the solutions that work for them, or assemble any custom combination they need. This makes it easier and faster to do things like introduce new products, reach customers and track orders. And this kind of innovation keeps customers coming back.

Cimpress Technology, a Cimpress company, is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national or ethnic origin, nationality, age, religion, citizenship, disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender presentation, legal or preferred name, marital status, pregnancy, family structure, veteran status or any other basis protected by human rights laws or regulations. Benefits Advisors play a key role in supporting LRQA’s global reward strategy through data analysis, business partnering, and operational delivery. They contribute to the development and implementation of compensation and benefits programmes that are aligned with business objectives and enhance the employee experience. The role requires a proactive and collaborative approach, working across teams to ensure reward practices are competitive, compliant, and effectively communicated.  


**Accountabilities**

* **Reward and Benefit Analysis:** Conduct analysis of internal equity, market competitiveness, and emerging trends to ensure LRQA’s reward offerings remain attractive, fair, and aligned with business strategy.
* **Business Partnering:** Collaborate with the People Team and business leaders to provide data\-driven insights and practical advice on reward solutions that support organisational goals and enhance employee experience.
* **Policy Development:** Support the development and maintenance of reward and benefit policies that are transparent, equitable, and consistent with LRQA’s values and governance standards.
* **Benefit Renewals:** Assist with benefit renewals globally, including data preparation and ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with business priorities.
* **Employee Communication:** Contribute to the creation of clear and engaging communication materials that help employees understand and appreciate their total reward package.
* **Data Management:** Maintain accurate and compliant records of reward and benefits data, supporting audit processes and regulatory reporting requirements.
* **Benchmarking \& Surveys:** Participate in benefits surveys, analyse market data, and provide recommendations to maintain competitive positioning.
* **Stakeholder Support:** Respond to benefit\-related queries from employees, People teams and business leaders, providing clear and timely guidance.
* **Vendor Support:** Liaise with insurance providers and brokers for renewals , employee issues and process improvements
* **Project Management:** Assist in the planning and execution of reward\-related projects, ensuring delivery within scope, budget, and timelines.
* **Drive Process Improvements:** Identify inefficiencies in reward operations and propose solutions to streamline workflows and improve service delivery.
* **Benefits Administration:** Assist with enrolment cycles, preparing business cases for approval, preparing data and dealing with invoices for vendor payments.

  


**Skills**

* **Pro\-active mindset:** Anticipates needs, identifies potential issues early and takes the initiative to drive solutions without waiting for direction.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Applies data\-driven insights to support benefit decisions, identify trends, and ensure accuracy in benchmarking and reporting.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Builds strong relationships, providing clear and timely advice on reward matters.
* **Communication:** Communicates complex reward concepts effectively, tailoring messages to diverse audiences and supporting employee understanding.
* **Process Management:** Supports cyclical reward activities and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring operational efficiency and compliance.
* **Market Awareness:** Monitors external trends and legislative developments to inform benchmarking and maintain competitive positioning.
* **Systems Proficiency:** Demonstrates working knowledge of HRIS platforms (e.g., SuccessFactors) and data tools (e.g., Excel), ensuring data accuracy and supporting system enhancements.
* **Governance \& Compliance:** Maintains awareness of regulatory requirements and ensures reward practices meet internal and external standards.
* **Project Support:** Contributes to the planning and delivery of reward\-related projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.

  


**Experience and qualification**

* **Educational Background:** Educated to university degree level in a relevant field such as Human Resources, Business, Finance, or Economics. A professional qualification in reward, compensation, or benefits is advantageous but not essential.
* **Professional Experience:** 2\+ years of experience in a reward or benefits role, ideally within a global or complex organisational environment. Familiarity with cyclical reward activities such as benefit renewals is preferred.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Experience working with HRIS platforms (e.g., SuccessFactors) and confident to use vendor platforms.
* **Analytical Capability:** Demonstrates analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data ad summarise findings.
* **Communication Skills:** Communicates clearly and effectively with stakeholders at all levels, supporting understanding of reward programmes and contributing to employee engagement.
* **Digital Proficiency:** Skilled in Microsoft Office applications, with specific proficiency in Excel to support data analysis and reporting.
* **Language Skills:** Fluent in written and spoken English. Additional language fluency is beneficial but not required.

description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Overview**


The India HR Compliance Background Investigations Analyst will play a vital role in leading compliant, risk\-based background check screening processes while ensuring adherence to applicable employment laws and data privacy regulations. As part of the Background Investigations team, this role serves as a subject matter expert on background investigations and hiring compliance, partnering cross\-functionally to manage risk, interpreting complex findings, and upholding the firm’s regulatory and ethical standards. The role ensures consistent and timely execution of background investigations in accordance with applicable firm policies and screening requirements, while applying sound judgement to identify and appropriately escalate complex, ambiguous, and time\-sensitive cases.


This position requires strong regulatory knowledge and critical thinking skills, analytical judgement, the highest level of confidentiality and discretion, and the ability to operate effectively and efficiently in a fast\-evolving compliance landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Background Investigations**

* Coordinate and facilitate pre\-employment background checks for India\-based hires primarily, as well as internal promotions, contractors, and client\-specific engagements.
* Liaise with external background check vendors to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely processing of investigations.
* Review and adjudicate background check results against firm standards and legal requirements, while applying sound risk\-based judgement, and escalating complex findings as appropriate.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, and Legal to manage exceptions, escalations, and adverse action processes.
* Continuously identify ways to enhance background investigation policies, controls, processes, vendor governance, and candidate experience.

**Compliance Oversight**

* Maintain detailed knowledge and subject matter expertise in Indian employment and data privacy laws related to compliance with hiring and background investigations (e.g., Shops \& Establishments Acts, Aadhaar restrictions, Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP), as well as knowledge of relevant U.S. and global regulations (e.g., Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Fair Chance Acts, GDPR, etc.).
* Monitor legislative changes and emerging industry risks impacting hiring compliance.
* Identify and proactively recommend controls to mitigate evolving risks within the hiring and background screening landscape including resume fraud, credential misrepresentation, synthetic identities, AI\-enabled candidate impersonation, automated application bots, and misuse of generative AI during interviews.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulatory requirements related to pre\-employment processes and adverse action.

**Training \& Education**

* Develop and deliver training for HR teams, hiring managers, and other stakeholders on background check processes and compliance obligations.
* Act as a trusted advisor on compliance best practices to minimize organizational risk.

**Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain complete, accurate, and audit\-ready background check records, communications, and compliance documentation.
* Prepare reports and dashboards on compliance activities, background check trends, audit findings, and metrics.

**Communication**

* Provide clear, timely, and relevant communication to candidates, employees, and other key stakeholders regarding background check results and compliance requirements.
* Handle all background check reports and sensitive information with the highest level of discretion, confidentiality, and professionalism, and on a strict need\-to\-know basis.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or related field.
* 3–5\+ years of relevant HR compliance, background investigations, or related experience.
* Experience within professional services, consulting, or multinational organizations preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of employment law, compliance frameworks, and regulatory requirements.
* Sound understanding and familiarity with Shops \& Establishments Acts, Aadhar regulations, FCRA, Fair Chance Acts, DPDP, GDPR, and global data privacy and compliance standards as it relates to employment and background investigations.
* Experience with HRIS systems, applicant tracking systems, and background screening tools.

**Core Competencies**

* **Judgement and Integrity:** Demonstrates strong ethical and sound decision\-making and uses the highest level of discretion and confidentiality in sensitive matters.
* **Analytical \& Problem\-Solving:** Ability to interpret complex data and resolve issues with minimal supervision.
* **Collaboration \& Communication:** Builds strong cross\-functional partnerships and communicates clearly, timely and effectively, both written and verbal.
* **Adaptability:** Operates effectively in dynamic, fast\-paced, evolving regulatory environments, and is comfortable with managing ambiguity and complexity while supporting change initiatives.
* **Operational Excellence:** Exceptional organizational, time management, and project management skills with strong attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and compliance.
* **Technical Proficiency**: Proficiency in HRIS and background check tools, Microsoft Office, data reporting, and AI tools.

**Preferred/Additional Requirements**

* Professional certification in HR compliance, employment law, or related field (e.g., HRCI, SHRM, XLRI, CCEP, etc.).
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive investigations or escalations with discretion.
* Global compliance experience (e.g., cross\-border background checks and compliance).
* Strong data analysis and reporting skills (Power BI, Tableau, or advanced Excel).


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

title: HR Compliance Background Investigations Analyst
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Overview**


The India HR Compliance Background Investigations Analyst will play a vital role in leading compliant, risk\-based background check screening processes while ensuring adherence to applicable employment laws and data privacy regulations. As part of the Background Investigations team, this role serves as a subject matter expert on background investigations and hiring compliance, partnering cross\-functionally to manage risk, interpreting complex findings, and upholding the firm’s regulatory and ethical standards. The role ensures consistent and timely execution of background investigations in accordance with applicable firm policies and screening requirements, while applying sound judgement to identify and appropriately escalate complex, ambiguous, and time\-sensitive cases.


This position requires strong regulatory knowledge and critical thinking skills, analytical judgement, the highest level of confidentiality and discretion, and the ability to operate effectively and efficiently in a fast\-evolving compliance landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Background Investigations**

* Coordinate and facilitate pre\-employment background checks for India\-based hires primarily, as well as internal promotions, contractors, and client\-specific engagements.
* Liaise with external background check vendors to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely processing of investigations.
* Review and adjudicate background check results against firm standards and legal requirements, while applying sound risk\-based judgement, and escalating complex findings as appropriate.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, and Legal to manage exceptions, escalations, and adverse action processes.
* Continuously identify ways to enhance background investigation policies, controls, processes, vendor governance, and candidate experience.

**Compliance Oversight**

* Maintain detailed knowledge and subject matter expertise in Indian employment and data privacy laws related to compliance with hiring and background investigations (e.g., Shops \& Establishments Acts, Aadhaar restrictions, Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP), as well as knowledge of relevant U.S. and global regulations (e.g., Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Fair Chance Acts, GDPR, etc.).
* Monitor legislative changes and emerging industry risks impacting hiring compliance.
* Identify and proactively recommend controls to mitigate evolving risks within the hiring and background screening landscape including resume fraud, credential misrepresentation, synthetic identities, AI\-enabled candidate impersonation, automated application bots, and misuse of generative AI during interviews.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulatory requirements related to pre\-employment processes and adverse action.

**Training \& Education**

* Develop and deliver training for HR teams, hiring managers, and other stakeholders on background check processes and compliance obligations.
* Act as a trusted advisor on compliance best practices to minimize organizational risk.

**Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain complete, accurate, and audit\-ready background check records, communications, and compliance documentation.
* Prepare reports and dashboards on compliance activities, background check trends, audit findings, and metrics.

**Communication**

* Provide clear, timely, and relevant communication to candidates, employees, and other key stakeholders regarding background check results and compliance requirements.
* Handle all background check reports and sensitive information with the highest level of discretion, confidentiality, and professionalism, and on a strict need\-to\-know basis.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or related field.
* 3–5\+ years of relevant HR compliance, background investigations, or related experience.
* Experience within professional services, consulting, or multinational organizations preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of employment law, compliance frameworks, and regulatory requirements.
* Sound understanding and familiarity with Shops \& Establishments Acts, Aadhar regulations, FCRA, Fair Chance Acts, DPDP, GDPR, and global data privacy and compliance standards as it relates to employment and background investigations.
* Experience with HRIS systems, applicant tracking systems, and background screening tools.

**Core Competencies**

* **Judgement and Integrity:** Demonstrates strong ethical and sound decision\-making and uses the highest level of discretion and confidentiality in sensitive matters.
* **Analytical \& Problem\-Solving:** Ability to interpret complex data and resolve issues with minimal supervision.
* **Collaboration \& Communication:** Builds strong cross\-functional partnerships and communicates clearly, timely and effectively, both written and verbal.
* **Adaptability:** Operates effectively in dynamic, fast\-paced, evolving regulatory environments, and is comfortable with managing ambiguity and complexity while supporting change initiatives.
* **Operational Excellence:** Exceptional organizational, time management, and project management skills with strong attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and compliance.
* **Technical Proficiency**: Proficiency in HRIS and background check tools, Microsoft Office, data reporting, and AI tools.

**Preferred/Additional Requirements**

* Professional certification in HR compliance, employment law, or related field (e.g., HRCI, SHRM, XLRI, CCEP, etc.).
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive investigations or escalations with discretion.
* Global compliance experience (e.g., cross\-border background checks and compliance).
* Strong data analysis and reporting skills (Power BI, Tableau, or advanced Excel).

title: HR Executive
description:
**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a proactive and dynamic Human Resource Executive to join our team and contribute to the success of our people operations. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the full employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding to employee engagement and compliance. You will play a key part in fostering a high\-performing culture, supporting the HR department, and ensuring that HR processes are executed efficiently and effectively. If you are passionate about people management and enjoy working in a collaborative environment, we’d love to hear from you!

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **End\-to\-End Recruitment:** Manage the recruitment process from start to finish. This includes sourcing, screening, and shortlisting candidates, scheduling and conducting interviews, coordinating with hiring managers, and ensuring a smooth and efficient recruitment process. Work with various teams to understand their staffing needs and proactively source talent across multiple channels.
* **Onboarding \& Employee Records:** Oversee the onboarding process for new employees, ensuring that they have a seamless experience from day one. Handle all documentation, including offer letters, contracts, and other onboarding paperwork. Ensure that employee records are maintained accurately and are up\-to\-date in the HRIS (Human Resource Information System).
* **HRIS Administration \& Attendance Management:** Administer and maintain the HRIS system, ensuring that all employee data is recorded, updated, and easily accessible. Track and manage employee attendance, absences, and leave requests, ensuring that all processes align with company policies and legal requirements.
* **Payroll Support \& Statutory Compliance:** Assist with payroll processing, ensuring timely and accurate payment of salaries, bonuses, and incentives. Support the HR team in handling statutory compliance matters such as Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and other relevant labor laws. Ensure all payroll\-related documentation is complete and compliant with local regulations.
* **Employee Engagement \& Team Building:** Help organize and manage employee engagement initiatives, team\-building activities, and other events that foster a positive and inclusive workplace culture. Encourage employee participation in events and collaborate with teams to improve overall employee satisfaction and morale.
* **Performance Management Support:** Assist in the performance management process, including coordinating feedback sessions, assisting with performance appraisals, and helping employees set development goals. Maintain records of performance reviews and ensure that they are conducted on time.
* **HR Policy Support:** Support the implementation and communication of company policies, procedures, and guidelines. Ensure that all employees are aware of their rights and responsibilities in the workplace and assist with any employee queries regarding HR policies.
* **Employee Grievance Handling:** Provide support in addressing employee concerns and grievances in a timely and professional manner. Ensure that any issues are escalated and handled according to company policies and best practices.
* **Employee Exit Process:** Manage the exit process for departing employees, including conducting exit interviews, handling resignation or termination paperwork, and ensuring that all formalities are completed smoothly. Provide insights from exit interviews to improve organizational practices.

**Required Skills:**

* **Recruitment \& Sourcing:** Experience in managing the full recruitment cycle, including candidate sourcing, screening resumes, conducting interviews, and working with hiring managers to select the best candidates for the role. Familiarity with various job boards, recruitment tools, and social media platforms for sourcing talent.
* **Onboarding \& Documentation:** Knowledge of employee onboarding processes, including preparing offer letters, contracts, and other essential documentation. Ability to ensure a smooth onboarding experience for new hires and help them integrate into the company culture.
* **HRMS (Human Resource Management System):** Proficiency in using HRMS platforms to manage employee data, track attendance, leave, and other HR\-related tasks. Experience with tools like BambooHR, Zoho People, or other HR software is a plus.
* **Compliance \& Payroll Support:** Understanding of statutory compliance, labor laws, and payroll\-related activities. Experience in assisting with payroll processing and ensuring compliance with government regulations, such as PF, ESI, and gratuity.
* **People Management:** Ability to build positive relationships with employees and management, providing guidance and support across all HR\-related functions. Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate with employees at all levels.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to communicate effectively with employees, management, and external parties. Strong listening skills and the ability to provide clear and concise information.
* **Problem\-Solving \& Multitasking:** Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities while remaining detail\-oriented. Strong problem\-solving skills to address employee concerns, recruitment challenges, and compliance issues effectively.

**Nice\-to\-Have Skills:**

* **HR Analytics:** Familiarity with HR analytics and reporting tools to provide insights into HR metrics, such as turnover rates, employee engagement, and recruitment success.
* **Knowledge of Employee Benefits:** Understanding of employee benefits programs (e.g., health insurance, leave policies, retirement benefits) and experience in administering these programs.
* **Workforce Planning:** Knowledge of workforce planning and organizational development principles. Ability to anticipate future hiring needs and assist with talent management strategies.

**Personal Attributes:**

* **Detail\-Oriented \& Organized:** Ability to manage large volumes of information accurately and stay organized in a fast\-paced environment. Attention to detail is essential for handling employee records, payroll, and compliance documentation.
* **Adaptable \& Resilient:** Ability to adapt to changing business needs and work effectively under pressure. Willingness to take on new challenges and responsibilities as the company grows.
* **Team Player:** Collaborative and supportive in working with various departments. Ability to contribute to a positive and productive work environment while supporting HR initiatives.
* **Confidentiality:** Strong sense of professionalism and discretion when handling sensitive employee information. Ability to maintain confidentiality in all aspects of the role.

title: HR Operations Specialist
description:
**HR Operations**

**Who we are?**

Johnson Controls is the global leader for smart, healthy and sustainable buildings. At Johnson Controls, we’ve been making buildings smarter since 1885, and our capabilities, depth of innovation experience, and global reach have been growing ever since. Today, we offer the world’s largest portfolio of building products, technologies, software, and services; we put that portfolio to work to transform the environments where people live, work, learn and play.


This is where Johnson Controls comes in, helping drive the outcomes that matter most. Through a full range of systems and digital solutions, we make your buildings smarter. A smarter building is safer, more comfortable, more efficient, and, ultimately, more sustainable. Most important, smarter buildings let you focus more intensely on your unique mission. Better for your people. Better for your bottom line. Better for the planet. We’re helping to create a healthy planet with solutions that decrease energy use, reduce waste and make carbon neutrality a reality. Sustainability is a top priority for our company.


We committed to invest 75 percent of new product development R\&D in climate\-related innovation to develop sustainable products and services. We take sustainability seriously. Achieving net zero carbon emissions before 2040 is just one of our commitments to making the world a better place.


Please visit and follow Johnson Controls LinkedIn for recent exciting activities.

**Why JCI:** **https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=nrbigjbpxkg**

**Asia\-Pacific LinkedIn:** **https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson\-controls\-asia\-pacific/posts/?feedView\=all**

**Career:** **The Power Behind Your Mission**

**OpenBlue:** **This is How a Space Comes Alive**

**How will you do it?**

**Skills \& Experience:**

* Provide specific assistance and processing WFA Processes, New Hires, Terminations, Employment Changes, Employment Verification, etc. including follow up with mangers and HRBPs to clarify information, obtain approvals or request corrections.
* Create new records, update, and maintain employee profiles and data in the respective HR systems of record.
* Process the transactions accomplishing KPIs defined per processes and according to the Case Management Framework and the SOX Matrix.
* Efficiently process purchase requisitions in compliance with procurement policies and guidelines by reviewing and validating requisition details, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
* Generate purchase orders based on approved requisitions, considering specified requirements and supplier agreements. Ensure purchase orders based on approved requisitions are correctly submitted to the right supplier.
* Contribute to the development, utilization and evaluation of internal processes to ensure efficient HR operations and customer service satisfaction.
* Identifies opportunities for process improvement as it applies to HR practices and implements changes as appropriate.
* Work within internal human resources information systems (HRIS; such as ServiceNow and Workday) to resolve broader issues or inquiries

**What we look for:**

* 2 \- 5 years of experience in a human resources role, preferably within an HR shared services environment.
* Should have worked on Workday Software (hands on exp of minimum 2 to 3 years)
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment.
* Flexible in shifts to support US

**What we offer:**


We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi\-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents

***Diversity \& Inclusion*** *Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High\-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. Our D\&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.*

The Shared Services Analyst I provides support for HR activities with a strong emphasis on learning and development, being the key contact for matters relating to process excellence and support. 15% Resolves Tier 1 and Tier 2 inquiries and collaborates with COE stakeholders for quick and effective resolution.


15% Supports programs and campaign rollouts by participating in solution review, testing, and knowledge article creation. Assists in maintaining course catalogue, logistics, and enrollment.


10% Compiles reporting and trend analysis supporting internal practice and program KPIs to help inform COE of program success and trending issues.


10% Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement initiatives and proposes solutions and ideas to find more efficient ways to deliver HR support to candidates, employees, and people leaders.

description:

**Reports to \-** Head of Human Resources

Bachelor’s Degree in **Engineering** (any stream) or **HR, Business Administration, or any relevant field**

MBA in HR is preferred

**Years of Experience**

3 – 6 years of experience in recruitment (manufacturing/industrial hiring mandatory)

Proven experience hiring for:

* **Factory/plant roles**
* **Engineering and technical positions**

Experience in startup or high\-growth hiring environment is a plus

**Position Summary**

We are looking for a **strong Recruiter with industrial/manufacturing hiring experience** to support rapid team building for our EV manufacturing plant in Chennai. This role will focus on hiring across plant operations, engineering, and support functions in a fast\-paced startup environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. End\-to\-End Recruitment**

* Manage full\-cycle recruitment: sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding
* Handle hiring for roles such as:
* Facility Manager, Maintenance or production Engineers
* Production, Quality, Supply Chain
* EHS, Admin, and support staff

**2\. Sourcing \& Talent Pipeline**

* Source candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn), consultancies, and referrals
* Build strong pipeline for **manufacturing and shop\-floor roles**
* Conduct market mapping in Chennai/Tamil Nadu region

**3\. Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements
* Provide insights on candidate availability, salary benchmarks, and hiring timelines

**4\. Screening \& Evaluation**

* Conduct initial HR screening and coordinate technical interviews
* Assess candidate fit for **startup and factory environment**

**5\. Offer \& Closure**

* Manage offer rollout, negotiation, and candidate closure
* Ensure smooth onboarding and joining process

**6\. Recruitment Operations**

* Maintain recruitment trackers and reports
* Ensure compliance with hiring processes and documentation

**Key Skills:**

* Strong understanding of **manufacturing roles and skillset**
* Hands\-on experience with job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter)
* Excellent stakeholder and candidate management skills
* Strong negotiation and closing ability
* Ability to work with speed and handle multiple roles

**Technical Skills:** 

* Strong understanding of **end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle**, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding
* Expertise in **manufacturing/industrial hiring**, including roles across production, maintenance, quality, supply chain, and plant operations
* Proficient in using **job portals and sourcing tools** such as Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other talent platforms
* Ability to **build and manage talent pipelines** for technical and shop\-floor roles within Chennai/Tamil Nadu market
* Skilled in **candidate assessment and screening**, including evaluating technical fit and cultural alignment for a startup environment
* Strong knowledge of **salary benchmarking, market mapping, and hiring trends** in the manufacturing sector
* Experience in **stakeholder management**, working closely with hiring managers to understand requirements and drive closures
* Strong **negotiation and offer management skills** to ensure timely hiring closures

**Authority:** 

* Ability to manage **multiple roles simultaneously** with speed and quality in a fast\-paced environment
* Proficient in maintaining **recruitment trackers, reports, and hiring metrics**
* Authorized to **manage end\-to\-end recruitment processes** for assigned roles
* Authorized to **source candidates through various channels** and build talent pipelines
* Authorized to **screen and shortlist candidates** based on role requirements
* Authorized to **coordinate and schedule interviews** with hiring managers and panel members
* Authorized to **drive offer discussions and negotiations** within defined compensation guidelines
* Authorized to **engage with external vendors/consultancies** for hiring support (as per company process)
* Authorized to **maintain recruitment data, reports, and hiring trackers**
* Authorized to **recommend hiring decisions and salary benchmarks** to stakeholders
* · Not authorized for **final offer approval, budget approvals, or policy decisions** (handled by HR Head / Leadership)

title: HR Projects & Transformation: Apprenticeship
description:
**Job Description:**

**Feeling ready to spread your wings ? What if your adventure started with us ?!**

**Whatever your dream job, we might have the Apprenticeship for you !**

**Are you a fresh graduate looking for an opportunity that will launch your career? Imagine yourself at the heart of an** **internationally recognized company** , established on every continent, and rich in diverse backgrounds, expertise, and cultures.


**Focused on digital** and at the **forefront of research and innovation** , you have the opportunity to be part of this exciting adventure.


**Your mission:**

**An apprenticeship opportunity titled : « Apprenticeship in HR Projects \& Transformation » has just opened at Airbus India located in Bangalore. You will join the "HR" department in charge of the Employee Development team.**

**Ideally, this is a** **12\-month program** and it should start in **\[July/2026]** (date subject to flexibility).  



  

**Your journey will be divided into three core pillars of transformation. Depending on your strengths and the team’s needs, you will lead or support initiatives across:**  



**Pillar 1: Talent Attraction \& Market Presence**

* **Boost our** **Employment Marketing** by creating content that tells the Airbus story to the external world.
* **Support the** **Recruitment lifecycle** by ensuring our Workday processes and candidate interactions are seamless and professional.

**Pillar 2: Organizational Culture \& Belonging**

* **Contribute to** **Culture Change** projects that bring our global values to life locally in India.
* **Help drive** **Inclusion \& Diversity (I\&D)** initiatives, ensuring our workplace remains a diverse and welcoming environment for all.

**Pillar 3: Capability Building \& Growth**

* **Support** **Learning \& Development (L\&D)** by coordinating training sessions and promoting a digital\-first learning mindset.
* **Assist in identifying the skills of tomorrow to ensure our workforce stays ahead of the curve.**

  

**Your tutor will support you identify your professional objectives and develop your skills**

**This apprenticeship will allow you to develop the following skills:**

**Project Management:** Learning how to plan and finish HR projects in a large global company.


**HR Digital Tools:** Getting hands\-on experience with tools like **Workday** and Google Workspace.


**Stakeholder Communication:** Learning how to work and talk with people from different departments and countries.  



  

  

  

**Your Boarding Pass:**  

  

**Eligibility Criteria:**

* **You are a** **Fresh Graduate** ( Post Graduate) in **\[Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or Communications.]** .
* **Zero Work Experience:** This program is exclusively for candidates with no prior full\-time professional work experience. (Internships and academic projects are excluded from this and are welcome).
* **Commitment:** Ability to commit to the full 12\-month duration of the apprenticeship.

**You possess the following competences:**

**\- Technical skills :**

* **Strong proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive).**
* **Comfort with digital platforms and an interest in HR technology and social media.**
* **Basic understanding of HR processes and employee engagement.**

**\- Soft Skills :**

* **Team Spirit: You like working with others and building relationships.**
* **Proactive: You take initiative, ask questions, and look for better ways to do things.**
* **Adaptable: You are happy to learn different parts of HR (Recruitment, Culture, or Learning).**

  

**\- Language skills :**

**\- English :Fluent/Advanced**

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.


**Company:**

Airbus India Private Limited
**Employment Type:**

Apprenticeship
\-


**Experience Level:**

Entry Level
**Job Family:**

HR Expertise \<JF\-HR\-CC\>
By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
  

Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.


Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com .


At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Job Description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

**Role**

The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery


**͏**
-----

**Do**

* Delivery Management
* Ensure seamless delivery of the projects
* Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement
* Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs

  

* Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
* Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA
* Liaise between customer and internal technical delivery team to drive project health by adhering to organizational norms of project metrics
* Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance
* Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations
* Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
* Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
* Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
* Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
* Client Relationship Management
* Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients

\- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
* Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
* Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
* Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
* Delivery governance across the project
* Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
* Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
* Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
* Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
* Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
* Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks
**͏**
-----

* Operational Excellence
* Automation Focus
* Perform pareto analysis as per the no. of incidents received and accordingly identify automation opportunities and drive value adds across the project
* Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery

  

* Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
* Innovation Focus
* Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
* Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
* Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
* Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing
* Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
* Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
* Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
* Demand forecasting in line with business requirements
* Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
* Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements

  

* Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
* Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
* Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements
* Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
* Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
* Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
* Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
* Fresher engagement program
* Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
* Team Management
* Resourcing
* Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
* Hire adequate and right resources for the team
* Talent Management
* Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
* Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization

  

* Manage team attrition
* Drive diversity in leadership positions
* Performance Management
* Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
* Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
* Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
* Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
* Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
* Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team

-----

2\.
  

  

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ operational efficiency

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Location: Pune, India**  

**Contract: Permanent, full\-time**

**About Us**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400\+ employees and 70,000\+ customers across 100\+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content.


Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.


Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.


Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.


**About Role**

Join a world leader in Cloud based software solution for the Space Designing industry. As a **Senior Software Engineer,** you will work on the Cyncly SaaS products Spaces Flex –3D WEB interior/exterior design software under 3D\-Workbox team and work on a TypeScript\-based application with real\-time 3D rendering built on an in\-house engine with integrated to content platforms.


Our engineering team is made up of SaaS skilled developers, architects and team leads and we have openings for other developers in the team. If you are looking for a challenging product development that offers learning and growth opportunities, apply for this position!


**Responsibility**

* Develop code that is performance\-oriented, cost\-effective, and follows company\-defined security standards.
* Elaborate interfaces using standards and design principles defined by the team.
* Develop systems with high availability.
* Well versed with Unit testing and PSR Standards.
* Master Software Development lifecycle, standards and technologies used by the team.
* Deliver on time with high quality.
* Write Automation tests to help out Automation SIT team.
* Trouble Shooting and debugging skills for faster defect fixing.
* Perform technical documentation of the implemented tasks.
* Provide guidance and mentoring to Interns/Freshers and other programmers.
* Identifies and recommends areas appropriate for further study and participates in any Proof of Concept projects required to thoroughly investigate architectural possibilities and strengthen arguments for their adoption
* Identifies implementation risks and analyses potential impact on the enterprise and on the achievement of scheduled objectives
* Recommends and participates in the design and implementation of standards, tools and methodologies.

**Required Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computers OR IT\-related courses.
* 6\-8 years of experience working in an agile environment with full stack development.
* **Must have:**
	+ Proficiency in front\-end technologies such as HTML, SCSS, **Tailwind** , JavaScript, **TypeScript** , and experience with frameworks like **ReactJS** , VueJS, or BackboneJS.
	+ Solid understanding of **2D/3D** concepts of **Geometry** (transforms, geometry, spatial mathematics, vector calculations, matrix, graph, etc)
	+ Proficiency in unit testing frameworks like JEST.
	+ Troubleshooting and debugging skills for issues and performance bottlenecks
	+ Cross\-browser and cross\-platform compatibility knowledge.
	+ Participation in code reviews and adherence to coding standards.
	+ Must have experience on responsive and adaptive UI development (Tablet and Phone based web app development)
* **Good to Have:**  

	+ Knowledge of the NX mono repo framework.
	+ Experience with state management libraries like React Zustand or similar.
	+ Good understanding on back ed technologies like NodeJS, C\#, Microservices, and .NET Core.
	+ Good understanding with NoSQL databases like **MongoDB** .
	+ Good understanding of Azure services and infrastructure.
	+ Strong grasp of SOLID design principles and design patterns.
	+ Ability to develop and optimize web pages for speed and scalability.
	+ Growth mindset and team player mentality.
	+ Experience working in a fast\-paced technology environment focused on delivering a world class product within an agile methodology utilizing latest technology frameworks.
	+ Technological mindset that keeps up on the latest technology, best practices and continues to learn and apply those learning's to the Cyncly environment
	+ Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain working relationships across disciplines and across the organization

**We Value**

* Good working knowledge of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery Practices.
* Experience with test driven development and Microservices architecture.
* Knowledgeable in common SCM practices, such as branching and code merges.
* Ability to work within an Agile Team with strong analytical, problem\-solving and communication skills.

description:

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.



By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi\-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

**About the Role**

  


Are you a tech\-savvy organizer who loves finding smarter ways to work?



As our India site continues its rapid scaling, we are looking for a next\-generation **Executive Assistant** to support the India Site Head. This isn't your traditional administrative role. We are looking for a "tech\-first" problem solver who leverages AI agents, automation tools, and large language models to streamline executive operations.



Whether you are an experienced EA looking to modernize your skill set, or a brilliant fresher with a passion for AI and organization, this role is your launchpad. You will be the operational backbone for the Site Head \- automating the mundane so the leadership team can focus on the extraordinary, while also bringing a human touch to our operations, serving as the primary host and culture champion for all visiting partners and site gatherings and events.

  


**What You'll Do**


**A) AI \& Workflow Automation**

  

* **Build the "Virtual EA":** Deploy and manage AI agents and automation workflows (using tools like Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or Power Automate) to handle routine tasks such as calendar triage, meeting invite acceptances, and basic email drafting.
* **Smart Follow\-Ups:** Design automated systems to track leadership action items, pending approvals, and project follow\-ups.

**B)** **Executive \& Site Support**

  

* **Strategic Calendar Management:** Manage complex scheduling for the Site Head, ensuring time is protected for high\-priority business initiatives.
* **Event \& Delegate Management:** Act as the primary host for visiting global executives, VIP delegates, and external partners.
* **Culture \& People:** Organize high\-impact site events, leadership offsites, and team\-building initiatives that foster a highly engaged work environment.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Act as a seamless liaison between the Site Head, the Chief of Staff, and the broader GCC leadership team.

  

  

**What You Bring**

  

* **Experience:** Open to both fresh graduates with a strong tech portfolio and experienced professionals with a proven track record of modernizing administrative workflows.
* **Tech Fluency:** Hands\-on experience (or strong demonstrated interest) in AI tools, prompt engineering, and basic workflow automation. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be extremely comfortable configuring AI agents to solve operational bottlenecks.
* **Exceptional Communication:** Flawless written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact confidently with global leadership and diverse teams.
* **Hyper\-Organized:** An innate ability to manage multiple moving parts, prioritize ruthlessly, and anticipate the needs of the executive office before they arise.
* **People Skills:** A warm, professional demeanour with a natural talent for hospitality, event hosting, and relationship building.

 **The Payoneer Ways of Working**


**Act as our customer's partner on the inside**
  

*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*


**Do it. Own it.**
  

*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*


**Continuously improve**
  

*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*


**Build each other up**

**About the company**

We're a growing farm\-to\-home food brand based in Coimbatore, delivering a fresh daily consumable to hundreds of families every morning, 365 days a year. Real farm, real product, real customers who talk about us. We will share our brand name once we shortlist.

* Hands\-on Instagram Ads Manager experience with real budgets.
* Tamil \+ English writing ability.

Food / dairy / hyperlocal brand experience, Canva design skill, WhatsApp Business familiarity.

Shortlisted candidates will do a 30\-min call and a short paid reel assignment (₹2,000 for your time). We'll share our brand name at the shortlist stage.

title: QC Inspector
description:
**Quality Control Inspector Job Description TemplateJob Brief**

We are in search of a diligent Quality Control Inspector to maintain the safety and efficiency of our products.

The Quality Control Inspector will be responsible for conducting regular inspections, identifying defects or deviations from standards, and taking corrective action.

The ideal candidate will possess a keen eye for detail, excellent technical skills, and a commitment to adhering to all safety and efficiency standards.

Ultimately, a top\-class Quality Control Inspector ensures that all products meet the required quality standards before they reach our customers.

**Responsibilities**:

* Inspect and test materials and products for defects and deviations from specifications.
* Use measuring tools to ensure products meet design specifications.
* Discard or reject products, materials, and equipment that do not meet specifications.
* Recommend adjustments to the assembly or production process to ensure quality standards are met.
* Monitor operations to ensure that they meet production standards.
* Discuss inspection results with production supervisors or other staff as necessary.
* Maintain a record of inspection or test data.
* Report inspection and test data to the Quality Control Manager.
* Identify opportunities for improvement and propose corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with safety and environmental guidelines.

**Qualifications:**

* Proven work experience as a Quality Control Inspector or in a similar role.
* Excellent knowledge of quality control standards and testing methodologies.
* Working knowledge of MS Office and data analysis software.
* Dexterity and precision in handling and testing products.
* Strong attention to detail, observation, organizational and leadership skills.
* In\-depth knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards.
* Proficient in reading and understanding technical documents and blueprints.
* High school diploma; Further certification in Quality Control is a plus.
* DME.

No one to design for you, edit your videos, or tell you what to post. You will own TradeClover's entire visual identity and social media presence from top to bottom. If you need direction on what to create, this is not for you. If you can build a brand presence from scratch and make it grow, keep reading.

**What You Must Know (Non\-Negotiable)**

* **Design:** Figma — UI mockups, social creatives, pitch decks, brand assets. Not just templates, actual design sense.
* **Motion \& Animation:** 2D animations using After Effects, Jitter, or equivalent. Motion graphics for reels, explainer videos, product walkthroughs. Not just transitions.
* **Video Production:** Scripting, shooting (basic), and editing full\-length videos — not just 30\-second reels. YouTube\-style content, demo videos, testimonials.
* **Short\-Form Content:** Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts — but this is the floor, not the ceiling.
* **Strategy:** Content calendars, platform\-specific strategies, growth planning, knowing what content to make and why.
* **Copywriting:** Writing captions, hooks, video scripts, and ad copy that actually convert. You understand tone.
* **Analytics:** Reading what works and what doesn't across Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube. You make decisions from data, not feelings.
* **Platform Fluency:** Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube — you understand how each algorithm works and you tailor content accordingly.
* **Brand Building:** You can take a B2B startup with zero presence and build something people recognize and trust.

**What You Will Own**

Everything creative. Brand identity, social presence across all platforms, video content, motion graphics, creatives for campaigns, ad visuals, onboarding decks, and anything else the company needs visually. You decide the strategy. You execute it. You measure it. You improve it.

**Who Should NOT Apply**

* Anyone who only knows how to make reels and post them
* Anyone who needs a designer to hand them assets to edit
* Anyone who has never made a video longer than 60 seconds
* Anyone who cannot think in strategy and only works execution
* Anyone looking for remote or hybrid work
* Anyone whose Figma skills go only as far as Canva\-style templates
* Freshers or anyone with under 3 years of real, end\-to\-end creative experience

**How To Apply**

Apply only if you meet every requirement listed above. Send your portfolio and resume to **tradeclover01@gmail.com** with the subject line: **Creative \& Social Media Manager — TradeClover**

Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Manager \- responsible for building and nurturing client relationships throughout the entire property lifecycle, from the initial booking to post\-possession services. This role requires a combination of technical CRM proficiency, strong communication skills, and knowledge of the real estate industry to maximize client retention and satisfaction.

Key responsibilities

A real estate CRM Manager's duties span administrative, strategic, and customer\-facing activities.

· Customer lifecycle management: Act as the single point of contact for clients after sales closure, overseeing all post\-booking activities up to the final handover of the property.

· Documentation and compliance: Ensure the timely and accurate execution of all legal documents, such as the Builder Buyer Agreement and Registration documents. Guarantee compliance with regulatory bodies like RERA.
