title: Regional Head HRBP
description:
We, RentoMojo, were founded by IITM alums and serial entrepreneurs who worked out of almost every major city in India in his first five years of corporate career. Frustrated with the hassles of relocating from one place to the other, and tired of finding that perfect cluster of home essentials that suited their lifestyle.
   

  

 "The spending youth, especially the millennials \& Gen Z's prefer staying light, desire flexibility and are value conscious. Willing to experiment with new stuff across categories that make life simpler and not boring, these generations are also sensitive to our planet's sustainability. Our customers and employees identify with what we do '', is what Geetansh Bamania, our Founder and CEO has to say.
   

  

 RentoMojo caters to the needs of the working professionals which is unmet due to nonavailability of furnished rental flats by offering furniture and appliances on rental basis, thus, providing more flexibility than owning the expensive furniture and appliances.
   

  

 Currently, we have 100,000\+ subscribers with a typical rental period of 12\-14 months. The current market size (as per a recent report by Grant Thornton) is estimated to be US$ 4\.1 Billion and expected to grow to US$ 13 Billion by 2025\.
   

  

 With 700\+ people operations, the company has a presence in 16 cities across India. Looking back, Rentomojo has not only made a new market of lease which never existed for the consumer, they have also become market leaders in the consumer rental industry. Unlike the norm, they are now seeing a reverse trend wherein a version of ours is being copied in the US and UK. We are also profitable at monthly PAT since Oct 2021\.

title: Talent Coordinator Lead
description:
**About The Role**
 At Uber, we pride ourselves on the amazing team we've built. The driver behind all our growth, our bold and ground\-breaking brand, and the game\-changing technology we bring to market is the people that make Uber, Uber. Delivering a first class, on\-demand transportation experience takes a critical eye for quality, and we need a Talent Coordination Lead who demands the same quality of themselves, and of the team they will be responsible for.
   

  

 Uber is a company that has built amazing products with motivated, hard working people. Our Talent Coordination team is looking for a Talent Coordination Lead to support our recruiting efforts locally and globally. The right person will thrive in an "all hands on deck" environment, loves finding solutions to problems, and can move quickly as a builder and doer in a thriving culture and will be passionate about finding ways to best support our growing Uber family.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead a team of Talent Coordinators responsible for partnering with recruiters and hiring managers on recruiting processes which includes: scheduling interviews, reserving conference rooms, working with executive assistants, and hosting candidates when they come onsite.
* Handle escalated employee issues from business leaders.
* Continuously mentor and develop coordinators to ensure goals are met
* Partner with Talent Acquisition leaders to ensure we are supporting them with bringing in phenomenal talent
* Identify operational weaknesses and help improve existing or develop new processes to keep the Talent Coordination team scale with Uber's growth
* Know the numbers \- drive the metrics used to evaluate TCs, including volume, speed, efficiency and quality.
* Set a high bar for the team to think boldly and creatively and then to funnel that energy into concrete processes and execution plans, adapt quickly, be biased toward action


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree, preferably in business / human resources
* 3\+ years of prior experience in a data driven organization leading support organizations/consulting/HR operations role. Prior people management experience is a plus.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Execution focus \- you drive towards results and can roll up your sleeves to get things done, both individually and with your team
* Self\-starter attitude \- you tackle your work and love the responsibility of being individually empowered, comfortable with being managed remotely
* Optimistic leadership \- you can serve as the guiding light for your team, through all types of situations
* Natural curiosity \- you're innovative, creative, and constantly looking for opportunities to tweak and optimize processes

title: KDN India_Consulting_ Change Management
description:
**About KPMG Delivery Network** 




  





 The world of global advisory, audit and tax compliance services for large multi\-nationals is rapidly changing and heavily dependent on technology. The KPMG Delivery Network (KDN) is a KPMG special purpose member firm offering a way for clients to leverage KPMG top talent and technology platforms through regional teams of specialists, enabling economies of scale and a new way of working that expands beyond local capability together with KDN, KPMG member firms can drive the sales and delivery of global solutions at a competitive price and in a repeatable and consistent manner.
 



  





 As a member of KDN, you’ll be a part of the KPMG family working alongside some of our profession’s most skilled practitioners on rewarding programs and initiatives that are changing the way business operates, delivering value to our clients, and driving positive change in the communities we serve.
 



 You’ll be enabling KDN accelerate new ways of working, using cutting\-edge technology and working together with our member firms located in nearly 150 countries to help us achieve our ambition to be the most trusted and trustworthy professional services firm. And through your work, you’ll build a global network and unlock opportunities that you may not have thought possible with access to great support, vast resources, and an inclusive, supportive environment to help you reach your full potential.
 



  





**Roles \& responsibilities** 




 As an Assistant Manager/ Consultant in Change management support the Changer Manager and team, additionally be the one in ensuring projects are delivered efficiently and effectively in end\-to\-end Change management cycle.
 



  




* Participate in client service delivery teams in the active execution of engagements, focusing on the people, technology, behavioral and cultural side of change for large\-scale transformations inclusive of org changes, process and technology
* Identify and analyze change impact, assess organizational readiness and support a change management strategy that mitigates risk and maximizes employee engagement
* Create actionable deliverables that support understanding across the organization and stakeholders; managing resistance to change and help ensure user readiness
* Design and deliver solutions that supports organizational change; incorporating the use of behavioral change methods and frameworks and can concisely communicate ideas through PowerPoint and other forms while adjusting style and level of details depending on audience
* Partner with business leaders, stakeholders and project teams to meet business objectives and help ensure deliverables are completed in a timely manner including articulation of complex issues, structuring clear and concise recommendations to a C\-level audience
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging teams to innovate and optimize processes for better efficiency and effectiveness.
* Translate transformation objectives into clear case for change, change vision, and adoption goals for impacted stakeholder groups.
* Align change activities with program milestones, governance forums, and delivery cadence in coordination with PMO and Agile teams.
* Conduct stakeholder identification, analysis, and segmentation, including persona mapping and impact profiling.
* Support leadership alignment journeys, including sponsor enablement, leadership action planning, and reinforcement mechanisms.
* Operate and manage change networks / change champion models to drive adoption at scale.
* Execute Change Impact Assessments (CIA) to assess role based, process, and technology impacts.
* Design and run business readiness assessments, adoption tracking, and go live readiness checkpoints.
* Develop and execute communication strategies and plans, including targeted messaging by stakeholder group and geography.
* Create high quality communication assets such as leadership messages, email campaigns, intranet content, videos, and go live materials.
* Coordinate change communications with program, technology, and business workstreams to ensure consistency and clarity.
* Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA) and support development of training strategies aligned to user roles and adoption risks.
* Oversee creation of training materials, deployment plans, and train the trainer models.
* Stakeholder Identification, Analysis, Engagement Approach and Plan and Identify stakeholders and drive targeted engagement
* Define Leadership Journey and enable sponsors and leaders to lead change
* Training Strategy Creation / Documentation / Rollout Plan Design and manage role‑based training rollout
* Manage day to day change workstream execution, including task tracking, risk and issue management, and status reporting.
* Prepare inputs for program governance forums, steering committees, and leadership reviews.
* Utilize delivery tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, BI dashboards) for tracking progress, dependencies, and adoption metrics.
* Owns end‑to‑end change workstream execution, stakeholder engagement, and adoption outcomes within programs.
* Assess organizational readiness and go‑live preparedness
* Develop and execute integrated change plans and Change Strategy.
* Analyze role‑based impacts across processes and systems and analyze the same.
* Evaluate training effectiveness and adoption outcomes
* Minimum 4 to 9 years of recent relevant work experience related to Change Management, Organizational Development or Human Resource Consulting; experience within a major consulting firm preferred
* Strong understanding of change management principles, methodologies and leading practices with previous experience with large scale organizational change efforts and has leveraged PowerPoint, Excel, MS Project and other Microsoft tools to develop work plans, articulate complex issues, analyze data and structure information
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to build and effectively manage relationships with stakeholders, senior management and staff working independently or as part of a team
* Demonstrated ability and a proven track record of success in delivering client services in a collaborative and fast\-paced environment.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to think strategically and execute methodically.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in change management and driving adoption of new technologies and processes.



  





**Educational and other information** 




 Education: Any Graduate/ Post Graduate.
 



 Location: Bangalore/ Pune
 



 Designation: Consultant/ Assistant Manager

title: Data Review – Specialist (Stability Protocol / Study Build Review)
description:
**Company Description**
 Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company which provides a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries. The Group believes it is the world leader in food, environment and pharmaceutical products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and for supporting clinical studies. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA.
   

  

 Group's key figures are approx. 6\.95 billion Euros turnover, over 950 laboratories across 60 countries and about 63,000 staff.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Summary:** 
 Eurofins Lancaster Laboratories is seeking a highly analytical and quality‑driven
 **Data Reviewer Specialist** 
 to ensure accuracy and compliance of all stability protocols and study builds prior to client release. This position plays a crucial role in safeguarding data integrity and ensuring that client expectations are consistently met.
   

  

 This role includes a structured training progression: the individual will be fully trained as a
 **Stability Protocol Writer / Study Builder** 
 prior to performing protocol and study review responsibilities. This ensures a deep understanding of both the technical content and system workflows that impact the quality of client deliveries.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Training Phase – Protocol Writing \& Study Building**
* Complete comprehensive training in protocol writing based on Eurofins‑generated quotes.
* Learn and practice building stability studies within the LIMS system following client‑provided protocols.
* Develop proficiency in interpreting client requirements, scientific documentation, and stability program workflows.


**Primary Role – Data Review**
* Perform detailed, independent review of stability protocols and study builds to ensure accuracy, completeness, and alignment with client expectations.
* Confirm that all protocol parameters (e.g., storage conditions, pull points, test plans) are correctly entered and consistent with both quotes and client\-provided documents.
* Verify compliance with GMP, internal SOPs, and industry guidelines.
* Identify discrepancies, errors, or gaps and communicate effectively with Protocol Writers, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to resolve issues.
* Ensure documentation is traceable, audit\-ready, and maintained in accordance with data integrity principles (ALCOA\+).
* Support continuous improvements in review workflows, documentation standards, and system utilization.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications Required:**
* Master’s degree in a scientific discipline (Chemistry, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field) or equivalent industry with 4\-6 years of experience.
* Experience or familiarity with GMP, data integrity expectations, and regulated laboratory environments.
* Ability to learn and work effectively within LIMS or similar informatics systems.
* Strong scientific comprehension and ability to interpret technical protocols, quotes, and study plans.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to constructively collaborate and provide clear feedback.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Key Candidate Attributes**
* Self\-motivation; excellent quality of work and attention to detail
* Ability to communicate effectively with coworkers and internal/external clients
* Ability to learn new tasks quickly and to move easily from task to task
* Ability to handle prioritization and multiple tasks simultaneously
* Ability to use a personal computer and learn necessary programs
* Good communication skills (oral and written)
* Organizational ability and good judgement
* Science background/education and/or laboratory experience
* Strong Math Skills
* Logical Thinking, Good Reasoning Ability
* Motivation to excel
* Coaching/mentoring of peers

description:

**Role** 




 The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 




 \- Delivery Management
   

 \- Ensure seamless delivery of the projects 
   

 \- Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement 
   

 \- Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs 
 



  

 \- Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
   

 \- Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA

 \- Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA

 \- Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations

 \- Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
 



 \- Delivery governance across the project
   

 \- Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project

 \- Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
 



 \- Innovation Focus
   

 \- Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
   

 \- Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
 



 \- Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
 



 \- Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing 
   

 \- Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
   

 \- Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
 



 \- Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
   

 \- Demand forecasting in line with business requirements 
   

 \- Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
   

 \- Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements
 



  

 \- Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
   

 \- Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
 



 \- Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements 
   

 \- Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
   

 \- Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
 



 \- Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
   

 \- Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
 



 \- Fresher engagement program
   

 \- Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
 



 \- Team Management
   

 \- Resourcing
   

 \- Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
   

 \- Hire adequate and right resources for the team
 



 \- Talent Management
   

 \- Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
   

 \- Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization
 



  

 \- Manage team attrition
   

 \- Drive diversity in leadership positions
   

 \- Performance Management
   

 \- Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
   

 \- Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
 



 \- Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
   

 \- Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
   

 \- Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
 



 \- Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team

 PCSAT, Brand score, no. of customer references, SDR/ QBR %, Pulse % satisfied (top 2 box), Zero surprise delivery escalation from the customer, adherence to project charter
   

  
   

 2\.
   

  
   

 Delivery Management ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢Â‚Â¬Ã¢Â€Âœ operational efficiency
   

  
   

 Contractual adherence %, Quality index, Utilization %, cost of delivery target, overdue indent, 100% SLA compliance, PEI % target, 100% usage of click to bill, % SAP loss for T\&M projects
   

  
   

 3\.
   

  
   

 Delivery Management ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢Â‚Â¬Ã¢Â€Âœ Financials
   

  
   

 Revenue target achievement, Operating margin %, leakage from OB to revenue, revenue per employee, CR realization target, process exceptions to be minimized, bench cost % of total cost, underrun % target for FPP projects, effort saving through NG\-1, NG\-2 initiatives
   

  
   

 5\.
   

  
   

 Capability Building
   

  
   

 % attrition, critical talent attrition%, % trained on new age skills, % of team trained in necessary behavioural skills, diversity ratio, % localization targets by market, billable rookie ratio, rookie/NJNB assimilation TATs, offshore mix
   

  
   

 6\.
   

  
   

 Team Management
   

  
   

 Team attrition %, Employee satisfaction score
   

  
 


 ͏

 Experience: 8\-10 Years
   

 .

Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: Operations Executive – Student Coordination
description:
**Company:** 
 Boston Institute of Analytics (BIA)
 



**Location:** 
 Andheri, Mumbai (On\-site)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 Freshers and candidates with internship experience may apply
 



**Compensation:** 
 As per role fit and company standards
 



**Industry:** 
 Education / EdTech
 



  





**About the Role** 




**The Boston Institute of Analytics (BIA) is a career\-focused education institution delivering industry\-aligned programs in data science, artificial intelligence, finance, cybersecurity, and analytics.** 




**We are hiring an Operations Executive** 
 to support the smooth day\-to\-day execution of academic delivery and classroom operations. This role involves coordination across academic teams, trainers, and internal departments to ensure scheduled classes run efficiently and operational processes remain organized.
 



 This position is ideal for fresh graduates or early\-career professionals looking to build a career in operations, coordination, and academic administration within an education environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Academic Scheduling \& Planning** 



* Create and maintain academic calendars for ongoing and upcoming batches.
* Plan classroom allocations based on batch size, course requirements, and availability.
* Coordinate session rescheduling when required due to operational or trainer availability changes.



  





**Trainer Coordination** 



* Manage trainer scheduling and session bookings.
* Coordinate with trainers regarding class timings, delivery formats (offline/online), and session requirements.
* Ensure trainers have required classroom or technical setups prior to sessions.



  





**Classroom \& Infrastructure Coordination** 



* Ensure classrooms are operational and ready before scheduled sessions.
* Coordinate with admin and IT teams for AV setup, internet connectivity, systems, and infrastructure needs.
* Monitor classroom utilization and report operational or maintenance concerns.



  





**Operational Execution** 



* Track daily class execution and proactively flag scheduling deviations or issues.
* Maintain records related to schedules, trainer assignments, and batch progress.
* Support onboarding and operational setup for new academic batches.



  





**Coordination \& Communication** 



* Act as a coordination point between academic, trainer, sales, and operations teams.
* Communicate schedule updates clearly and in a timely manner.
* Assist academic leadership with operational reporting and coordination support.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Fresh graduates or candidates with internship/coordination experience are encouraged to apply.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple schedules and deadlines simultaneously.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and calendar management tools.
* Willingness to learn and grow within an operations\-focused role.



  





**What You’ll Gain** 



* Hands\-on exposure to academic and operational management within a growing education organization.
* Structured learning environment with practical responsibilities.
* Career growth opportunities into roles such as Senior Operations Executive, Program Coordinator, or Academic Operations Manager.
* Collaboration with trainers and cross\-functional teams across multiple domains.



  





**Work Location** 




**Andheri, Mumbai — On\-site role.** 




  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




**The Boston Institute of Analytics evaluates applicants based on skills, qualifications, and role requirements and is committed to fair and inclusive hiring practices.**

title: School Mentor
description:
**Job description** 




  





**The requirement is based out of Mumbai. You would first travel to our office in Bandra (E), and then travel to 1 or 2 nearby schools in a day in South Bombay. We have Uber facility.**

* Deliver hands\-on sessions in Robotics, CAD, and Programming for school students in an engaging and effective manner.

* Exposure to wireless test automation frameworks.

 **CWNA/CWAP** 
 , CCNA Wireless (optional).

description:

 As a Network Performance Optimization (NPO) Specialist, you will monitor and analyze network performance, identify and diagnose root causes of issues, and implement optimization actions such as QoS adjustments, parameter tuning, and software upgrades to ensure continuous performance.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Lead and serve as the primary contact for specific technical domains and Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), managing project deliverables independently.

* Experience in using techniques like packet\-capture/packet\-analysis, load testing, and traffic\-path analysis to troubleshoot network\-latency, packet\-loss and performance issues.

* Experience with open source software communities, cloud networking solutions, distributed\-computing technology or hybrid/multi\-cloud connectivity.
* Knowledge of virtual/container networking, web technologies, HTTP/HTTPS, network administrator level Linux/Unix or other Operating System (OS).
* Ability to work in shifts.


**About The Job**
 The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem\-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross\-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.
   

  

 In this role, you will be a part of a Global team that provides support to help customers switch to Google Cloud. You will troubleshoot technical issues for customers with debugging, networking, system administration, documentation updating, and coding/scripting. You will make the products easier to adopt and to use by making improvements to the product, tools, processes, and documentation. You will help drive business growth of Google Cloud by recognizing and advocating for the customer issues.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage the customers issues through diagnosis, resolution, or implementation of new investigation tools to increase productivity for customer issues on Google Cloud Platform products.
* Develop knowledge of Google's product technology and underlying architectures by troubleshooting, reproducing, planning the root cause for customer reported issues, and building tools for diagnosis.
* Act as a consultant and subject matter expert for internal stakeholders in engineering, business, and customer organizations to resolve technical deployment issues and improve Google Cloud.
* Understand customer issues and advocate for their needs with cross\-functional teams including Product and Engineering teams to find ways to improve the product, and drive production.
* Work as part of a team of engineers or consultants that ensure customer support globally. Work non\-standard hours/shifts as needed.

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
**Title**
**Technical Writer / Senior Technical Writer**
**Position Overview**
 As a Technical Writer / Senior Technical Writer at LTSCT, you will be responsible for developing high\-quality product documentation that supports semiconductor hardware, software, and firmware solutions. This role requires the ability to understand complex technical concepts—spanning semiconductor technologies, associated subsystems, and software/firmware workflows—and translate them into clear, concise, user\-focused content.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams including Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and globally distributed teams to gather information, structure documentation, and ensure consistency across deliverables. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong proficiency in structured authoring (DITA), single\-sourcing methodologies, and documentation lifecycle management using CCMS platforms. This role demands excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment while consistently meeting deadlines.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Create complete, high\-quality product documentation from the ground up, adhering to organizational standards and project timelines.
* Update documentation to reflect changes in product versions, features, specifications, and industry standards.
* Use structured authoring methodologies (e.g., DITA) to create reusable content modules.
* Maintain a single source of truth for documentation to support consistent outputs across multiple formats.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, and Quality teams to gather technical information and simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.
* Review and edit documentation for grammar, accuracy, clarity, and technical correctness.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards such as IEEE, ISO, and JEDEC when documenting processes or specifications.
* Work effectively with both local and global teams across different time zones.
* Contribute to the development of standard diagrams, illustrations, videos, and presentations.
* Support special projects involving content review, proofreading, editing, and formatting for internal and external audiences.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (preferably ECE, EEE, CSE), Technical Communication, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience as a Technical Writer, preferably in semiconductor hardware, software, and firmware documentation.
* Ability to design clear technical diagrams, architecture workflows, and visuals using Visio, Draw.io, or Adobe Illustrator.
* Experience using collaboration tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
* Exposure to documentation automation workflows (CI/CD publishing, Git branching, versioning pipelines, or scripted builds).
* Proven ability to manage documentation projects throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Strong experience with CCMS platforms and structured authoring methodologies to drive content reuse and maintain version control.


**Mandatory Skills**
* Proven expertise in DITA XML authoring and single\-sourcing practices.
* Proficiency in industry\-standard documentation tools such as Oxygen XML Editor or equivalent XML/DITA\-based editors.
* Experience collaborating directly with SMEs such as design engineers, firmware developers, and validation teams to extract technical information.
* Hands\-on experience working with product engineering teams, understanding development lifecycles, sprints, and review workflows.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to validate technical content against design specifications, datasheets, and release notes.
* Strong command of English writing, editing, and technical communication standards.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with CCMS\-based documentation tools, preferably Vasont Inspire.
* Experience writing and maintaining programming guides, user manuals, firmware guides, feature descriptions, and release documentation for semiconductors or SoC products.
* Experience documenting APIs, AT command sets, SDK workflows, or developer\-facing technical content.
* Familiarity with semiconductor terminology, chip architecture, block diagrams, and hardware development concepts.
* Knowledge of documentation automation, scripting, or Git\-based workflows.
* Ability to create multimedia content such as short videos, tutorials, or animations for product documentation.

title: Software Development Engineer, JWO
description:
**Description**
 As part of the AWS Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.
   

  

 The Team: From the merchandise stores at Sports venues to small\-format stores such as Amazon Go, a new kind of technology is powering stores with no lines and no checkout. You simply use the Amazon app to enter the store, take what you want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals, grocery essentials and merchandise, and go.
   

  

 Our checkout\-free shopping experience is made possible by our Just Walk Out (JWO) Technology. It automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to the shelves and keeps track of them in a cart. When you’re done shopping, you just leave the store. Shortly after, we’ll charge your Amazon account and send you a receipt. Designed and custom\-built by Amazonians, our technology uses computer vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning. Innovation is part of our DNA. We need people who want to join a high\-reaching program that continues to push the state of the art in computer vision, machine learning, distributed systems and hardware design.
   

  

 The Role: Everyone on our team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats and work in a highly collaborative environment that’s more startup than big company. We’re solving problems that span a broad range of domains: computer vision, image recognition, machine learning, and distributed systems. This role involves building/scaling Machine Learning platform used for developing all the algorithms at JWO.
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer, you will help solve a variety of technical challenges and mentor other engineers. You will play an active role in translating business and functional requirements into concrete deliverables and build quick prototypes or proofs of concept in partnership with other technology leaders within the team. You will help invent new features, design, develop and deploy reliable distributed services. You will work with a variety of core languages and technologies including Java, C\+\+, Linux.
   

  

 You will tackle challenging situations every day and you’ll have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon. You should be comfortable with a degree of ambiguity that’s higher than most projects and relish the idea of solving problems. Along the way, we guarantee that you’ll learn a ton, have fun and make a positive impact on many customers.
   

  

 The Role: You are a talented Software Engineer who knows how to design and code full\-stack solutions. You know how to get things done, and done really well. You are a dreamer and a futurist. You have an inventor’s spirit, a can\-do approach and proficiency in a wide range of design technologies, and a killer eye for detail. We are looking for talented engineers for Java and AWS services.
   

  

 In this role you’ll have the opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a game\-changing initiative. While you’ll be able to use existing Amazon systems when possible, you’ll be working on challenging problems that need creative solutions. You should be comfortable building prototypes, challenging assumptions, and thinking of creative ways to tackle challenges.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications·**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* Programming experience with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design
* 1\+ years contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems


**Preferred Qualifications·**
* Engineering in Computer Science or related field
* Experience as a key member of a full\-stack engineering team participating in the complete product development life cycle of successfully launched applications.
* Experience with designing and building systems in a multi\-tiered, distributed environment (Service Oriented Architecture).
* Understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and project planning/execution skills including estimating and scheduling.
* Experience optimizing for short\-term execution while planning for long\-term technical capabilities. Ability and willingness to multi\-task and learn new technologies quickly.


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3\+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

title: HR Specialist
description:
Startdatum: z.s.m.


Bij JINC geloven we dat ieder kind gelijke kansen verdient. Om onze maatschappelijke missie waar te maken, hebben we een sterke en goed georganiseerde interne organisatie nodig.


Daarom zoeken wij een HR Specialist die graag meedenkt over het ontwikkelen, verbeteren en borgen van HR\-beleid, en dit weet te vertalen naar duidelijke processen en een zorgvuldige uitvoering. Daarnaast voel jij je thuis in salarisadministratie en zorg je ervoor dat alles achter de schermen soepel en correct verloopt.


Heb jij oog voor detail, neem je graag verantwoordelijkheid en wil je met jouw HR\-kennis bijdragen aan een organisatie met echte maatschappelijke impact? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

**Dit ga je doen**


Als HR Specialist ben jij dé inhoudelijke expert op het gebied van salarisadministratie en HR\-processen. Je zorgt dat alles achter de schermen klopt en alles goed is vastgelegd. Je werkt nauw samen met je collega´s van HR, waarbij iedereen met zijn eigen specialisme bijdraagt aan een sterk HR binnen JINC.

* Je bent onder andere verantwoordelijk voor:
* Het verwerken en beheren van de salarisadministratie, bij voorkeur in AFAS;
* Borgen van correcte toepassing van arbeidsrechtelijke en salarisgerelateerde wet\- en regelgeving;
* Opstellen, actualiseren en beheren van HR\-beleid, richtlijnen en procedures;
* Beheer en optimalisatie van HR\-processen en administratieve workflows;
* Signaleren van risico’s en verbetermogelijkheden binnen HR\-administratie en systemen;
* Samen met het team denk je mee over en geef je vorm aan diverse HR\-thema’s.

 **Wat breng jij mee?**

* Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring binnen HR en/of salarisadministratie;
* Aantoonbare ervaring met salarisadministratie en verschillende HR\-thema’s;
* Kennis van HR\-systemen; ervaring met AFAS is een sterke pré;
* Goede kennis van relevante wet\- en regelgeving;
* Je werkt nauwkeurig, analytisch en gestructureerd en bent beleidsmatig sterk;
* Beleidsmatig en analytisch sterk: je vertaalt inzichten naar concrete HR\-oplossingen
**Het HR\-team**  

Als HR\-adviseur kom je te werken in een gedreven en gezellig team van HR\-professionals. Ons HR team \- jouw directe collega’s \- zijn Fatma (HR adviseur), Aniek (HR Adviseur), Kelsey (HR Adviseur), Anouk (HR Stagiaire), en Joyce (Teamleider HR).


We werken twee vaste dagen op kantoor (Utrecht) en zijn ook regelmatig op andere JINC\-vestigingen door het land te vinden. We beginnen iedere week met een weekstart en iedere ochtend met een gezamenlijke dagstart.  

Je 200\+ nieuwe JINC\-collega’s zijn gedreven, gemotiveerd en houden van verbinden en samenwerken. Bovendien zijn we intrinsiek gemotiveerd in ons streven een inclusieve organisatie te zijn en blijven.

**Wat bieden wij jou**
----------------------

  

* Een impactvolle baan in een **inclusieve** organisatie. En een betrokken en energiek team dat samenwerking belangrijk vindt.
* Bij ons ben je nooit uitgeleerd: met een ruim **trainingsaanbod en loopbaanbudget** stimuleren we jouw groei.
* Een salaris volgens de cao Sociaal Werk. De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 7 (€ 3\.132 tot maximaal € 3\.290 bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur). Bij aantoonbare senioriteit en ruime ervaring in de functie is inschaling in schaal 8 bespreekbaar.
* Daarnaast zorgen we goed voor je toekomst met een uitstekend pensioenplan.
* Met een **individueel keuzebudget** van 17% kies je zelf: extra vrije dagen, een opleiding of een salarisboost.
* Een tijdelijk contract van 12 maanden met de intentie om voor langere tijd met elkaar het avontuur aan te gaan.


Je standplaats is Utrecht, maar je reist ook regelmatig naar onze vestigingen. Hiervoor krijg je een NS Business Card tot je beschikking.

**Inclusiviteit**


Bij JINC streven we naar een organisatie die een afspiegeling is van de samenleving. We moedigen iedereen aan om te solliciteren, ongeacht achtergrond, leeftijd, gender, seksuele oriëntatie, beperking of overtuiging. We kijken vooral naar wie jij bent en wat jij meebrengt.

 **Enthousiast?**


Ben jij enthousiast om een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan de missie van JINC? Aarzel dan niet en solliciteer meteen door op de actieknop rechts van deze pagina te klikken.


In het wervingsproces, beginnend met een telefoongesprek, gevolgd door in\-person gesprekken op kantoor en het maken van een casus, krijg je de kans om je vaardigheden en enthousiasme te laten zien.


Sollicitaties worden doorlopend beoordeeld; bij voldoende geschikte aanmeldingen sluiten we de vacature.


We kijken ernaar uit om jou te ontmoeten en te ontdekken hoe je bij ons team past.


Heb je vragen over het sollicitatieproces? Neem contact op met het HR\-team.


Een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag is vereist voor alle functies bij JINC. De kosten hiervoor worden vergoed.

title: Manager- Talent Acquisition Business Partner
description:
**Job Title Manager \- Talent Acquisition**
-------------------------------------------


Career Level: D3


Introduction to role


We are looking for a results\-driven Recruitment Manager (IC) to independently manage end\-to\-end hiring while partnering closely with business stakeholders. This role focuses on delivering high\-quality talent through effective sourcing, strong stakeholder management, expertise in AI platforms and data\-driven recruitment practices. Ready to shape how we attract the people who power life\-changing science?

**Accountabilities**
--------------------


Lead and execute end\-to\-end recruitment for a defined portfolio, from intake briefing through to offer and onboarding, ensuring a seamless experience for candidates and hiring managers.


Partner with business leaders to understand workforce needs, advise on market insights and design targeted hiring strategies that balance speed, quality and diversity.


Use AI platforms, digital tools and data to build sourcing strategies, track funnel performance and continuously improve time\-to\-hire and quality\-of\-hire.


Manage the country relocation process for new hires, coordinating with internal partners and external vendors to ensure a smooth transition.


Conduct interviews and pre\-selection assessments, providing clear recommendations based on role requirements and behavioural fit.


Oversee offer management, including negotiation within policy, and ensure all hiring administration is accurate, compliant and timely.


Collaborate with colleagues across the global recruitment community to share best practices, pilot new approaches and drive innovation in how we attract talent.


Good experience with ATS platforms \& AI based hiring tools like LinkedIn AI / Hiring Assist etc.


Champion our employer brand in every interaction, ensuring candidates experience a transparent, respectful and engaging process. This applies to both lateral \& campus recruitments alike.

**Essential Skills/Experience**
-------------------------------


Develop strong relationships within the Global Recruitment organization to gather input for creating effective marketing strategies, processes, and standards to measure success.

* Ensure all communication messages and materials provide consistent messaging aligned with the corporate position and adhere to the brand guidelines.
* Facilitate responses and engagement within recruitment\-related social network platforms by monitoring activity, collaborating with relevant teams, and drafting accurate responses.
* Assist managers in analyzing recruitment channels such as employee referral programs, job boards, social networks, events, advertisements, websites, emails, and campaigns to optimize performance.
* Coordinate and deliver the Global Employee Referral Program, ensuring the process is effectively executed across targeted segments within the organization.
* Collaborate with Recruitment Marketing agencies to develop or review all communications intended for candidates, applicants, and new hires, ensuring alignment with recruitment brand strategies and messaging.
* Gather and analyze candidate feedback from multiple sources to enhance recruitment strategies and communication effectiveness.
* Strategically contribute to College Relations and participate in career fairs and conferences to maintain brand consistency and optimize outreach efforts.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**
-------------------------------


Experience working with AI\-enabled sourcing or recruitment platforms.


Background in managing end\-to\-end recruitment in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.


Exposure to relocation processes or mobility coordination within a country.


Familiarity with data\-driven recruitment metrics and dashboards.


Comfort working in cross\-functional teams and influencing stakeholders without direct line management.


When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to


inspire life\-changing medicines. In\-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge


perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that


doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual


flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.


At AstraZeneca, talent professionals join a global community that powers the enterprise to move faster and smarter for patients every day. Working alongside bright, digitally savvy colleagues, there is freedom to experiment with new technology, apply data\-driven thinking and turn ideas into reality at pace. Curiosity is encouraged, smart risks are supported, and impact is visible as better hiring directly enables scientific breakthroughs that change lives. With varied projects, room to grow in different directions and recognition for strong performance, this is a place where ambitious self\-starters can build a powerful reputation while contributing to something that truly matters.


If this role sounds like the next step in your journey, apply now and help shape the future of talent at AstraZeneca!

* Work on live project components with increasing independence
* Raise problems early and communicate what you have already tried
* Continuously improve your technical foundation

C1: Critical Thinking

C2: Curiosity

* Ability to accept and apply feedback constructively
* Strong foundation in programming logic, data structures, and problem\-solving

title: Junior BIM Engineer
description:
Job Title: BIM Modeler

Department: VDC

Job Description: As a BIM Modeler in the civil engineering domain, you will play a key role in the creation, coordination, and management of digital models that represent various stages of building and infrastructure projects. You will collaborate closely with architects, engineers, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure accurate and effective project development. Your proficiency in BIM software and your understanding of civil engineering principles will contribute to the successful execution of projects.

​

Responsibilities:

​

* Develop accurate 3D models of building and infrastructure elements using BIM software (e.g., Autodesk Revit, Bentley MicroStation) based on project specifications, design drawings, and engineering data.
* Integrate relevant data, including dimensions, materials, structural details, MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) components, and other relevant attributes into the BIM model.
* Collaborate with architects, structural engineers, MEP engineers, and other project stakeholders to ensure interdisciplinary coordination and clash detection, resolving any conflicts in the digital environment before construction begins.
* Generate 2D drawings and documentation derived from the BIM model, including plans, sections, elevations, and construction details, ensuring alignment with project standards.
* Create visual representations and renderings of BIM models to help stakeholders better understand design intent, construction sequencing, and project progress.
* Extract quantities of materials and components from the BIM model to support cost estimation, procurement, and scheduling.
* Update and maintain the BIM model throughout the project lifecycle, reflecting design changes, field modifications, and as\-built conditions.
* Review and validate the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of the BIM model and associated documentation.
* Engage in regular communication and coordination meetings with project team members to ensure a smooth workflow and address any BIM\-related concerns.
* Provide assistance and training to colleagues regarding BIM software usage and best practices.

Qualifications:

​

* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a related field.
* Proficiency in BIM software, such as Autodesk Revit, Bentley MicroStation, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of civil engineering principles and construction processes.
* Familiarity with industry standards, codes, and regulations related to building and infrastructure design.
* Attention to detail and strong problem\-solving skills.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work within project deadlines and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* In this role, you'll contribute to the transformation of traditional construction practices by leveraging technology to improve project outcomes, reduce errors, enhance collaboration, and streamline construction processes.

Job description:

Job description:

**I. Role Summary**

The Field Agronomist represents CropMentor Technologies Pvt. Ltd. at the ground level. The FA’s primary responsibility is to establish direct relationships with farmers, explain the Company's **Contract Farming Model**, achieve targets for Vermicompost sales, and assist in the crop buy\-back process. This role is **100% Result\-Oriented** and highly accountability\-driven.

**II. Core Responsibilities**

**A. Sales and Contract Acquisition**

* **Farmer Onboarding:** Actively identify, approach, and motivate new farmers to enroll in the Contract Farming program.
* **Target Achievement:** Aggressively meet and exceed the daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets for the Vermicompost product.
* **Advance Payment Collection:** Ensure the successful and timely collection of **100% advance payment** for Vermicompost from the farmer, as mandated by the agreement.
* **Contract Execution:** Facilitate the process of executing formal Contract Farming Agreements (including the buy\-back clause) with farmers.
* **Lead Generation:** Generate new sales leads through door\-to\-door visits and organized farmer meetings within the assigned micro\-territory.

**B. Customer Service and Technical Compliance**

* **Technical Guidance:** Educate farmers on the application of Vermicompost, the cultivation of the Directed Crop, and adherence to company\-approved technical standards.
* **Compliance Monitoring:** Conduct regular farm visits to monitor and ensure that farmers are strictly adhering to the terms of the agreement and technical guidelines.
* **Buy\-Back Assistance:** Assist the TM and RSM during harvest with quality verification and the final crop procurement process.

**C. Reporting and Administration**

* **Daily Reporting:** Provide detailed daily reports to the Territory Manager (TM) on farmer visits, sales progress, and the status of payments collected.
* **Record Maintenance:** Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of all sales transactions, farmer data, and contract copies.
* **Market Feedback:** Collect and communicate feedback to the TM regarding pricing, product performance, and farmer concerns in the market.

**III. Required Qualifications**

Graduation in any discipline or a Diploma in Agricultural Science.

**Experience: Minimum 1\-3 years of proven Field Sales experience** in Agri\-Input, Microfinance, or Direct Sales.

**Skills:** Excellent communication (Hindi and local dialect), negotiation skills, and a strong target\-oriented approach.

**Other:** In\-depth knowledge of the local area, **personal two\-wheeler is mandatory**, and willingness to travel extensively within the territory.

title: Temenos Triple'A Plus (TAP) Business Analyst
description:
****Capgemini is seeking a skilled Temenos Triple'A Plus (TAP) Business Analyst to join our dynamic team.****
 The successful candidate will play a vital role in bridging business requirements and technology solutions within banking and financial services projects, particularly focusing on Temenos TAP implementations and enhancements. We'd particularly like to hear from you if you have experience working in TAP Wealth management solution. These roles represent a unique opportunity build your career as a Banking I.T. professional and gain further exposure to some of the world's top banking institutions.
   

  

 As a vital part of our business unit, you'll contribute to first\-class end\-to\-end solutions in your assignments. You will play an active role in defining our practices, standards and ways of working, and apply them to your role. Be open to working across organisation and team boundaries to ensure we bring the best to our customers.
   

  

 Our Banking and Diversified Financials practice helps clients shape, define and deliver banking transformation initiatives across the entire span of the organisation (front office to back office). This encompasses driving process improvement and process digitisation to enhance customer experience and delivery straight\-through digital processing and self\-service across the bank.
   

  

 Key areas of focus are around wealth management, payments, structured products and money market products. Working closely with clients, product owners, and technical teams, you will gather, analyze, and document business processes and requirements to ensure successful delivery of banking software solutions aligned with strategic goals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities include:**
* Provision of specific TAP expertise to enable delivery teams
* Gather requirements from the Business and work, document them with work with the TAP technical teams to translate the end user requirements to application/system requirements
* Reviewing requirements documents provided by the clients
* Build customization on TAP solution using the TAP scripting language
* Performing code reviews, creating code review standards,
* Mentoring and guiding the developers to adhere to the coding standards
* Training the team members in TAP Business Analysis
* Configuring TAP GUI, TAP WUI, Financial Servers and eco\-system components like WTX / TTI / Actuate etc
* Expertise in configuring \& tailoring Strategies, Constraints, PTCC checks, Formats, Screens, Reports etc covering various F2B \& B2f processes for Asset classes Securities, derivatives, Forex products, structured products, forwards and spots, money market products
* Documenting functional specification and Test artefacts
* Expertise in preparing meaningful, concise and aesthetically pleasing power point presentations
* Conduct functional trainings on TAP
* Collaborate with partners within and outside Capgemini to build assets \& accelerators


**Requirements**
**Functional Skills:**
* Minimum 10\+ years' experience as a TAP WUI or GUI SME with a large organisation
* Minimum 5\+ years of non\-TAP experience, preferably in Wealth Management, acting as BA Lead for at least 2 years.
* Strong analysis skills with wealth expertise, possessing significant work experience and in\-depth knowledge of wealth products like securities, Bonds, Mutual Funds, Structured Products, Derivatives, Forex, forwards, spots etc
* Understand the Wealth Management and Private Banking business and eco system \- Custodian, Depository, Broker, Registrar etc
* Experience preparing good quality Functional Design/Technical specifications/Test cases
* Familiarity with Agile, Scrum in particular and the use of Jira
* Able to work as Team player as well as independently without any supervision


**Soft Skills:**
* Strong client management skills
* Confident and articulate \- excellent verbal and communication skills
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Able to build relationship with business stakeholders and other team members
* Ability to lead a team


**Benefits**
 Competitive compensation and benefits package:
   

  

* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career development and training opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office\-based)
* Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
* Private Health Insurance
* Retirement Benefits
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development
* Performance Bonus


 Note: Benefits differ based on employee level.
   

  

**About Capgemini**
 Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. The Group is guided everyday by its purpose of unleashing human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 59\-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group €22\.5 billion in revenues in 2025\.

Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
**Role Purpose** 




 The purpose of the role is to liaison and bridging the gap between customer and Wipro delivery team to comprehend and analyze customer requirements and articulating aptly to delivery teams thereby, ensuring right solutioning to the customer.
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 




 1\. Customer requirements gathering and engagement
 


* Interface and coordinate with client engagement partners to understand the RFP/ RFI requirements
* Detail out scope documents, functional \& non\-functional requirements, features etc ensuring all stated and unstated customer needs are captured
* Construct workflow charts and diagrams, studying system capabilities, writing specification after thorough research and analysis of customer requirements

* Empower the customers through demonstration and presentation of the proposed solution/ prototype
* Maintain relationships with customers to optimize business integration and lead generation
* Ensure ongoing reviews and feedback from customers to improve and deliver better value (services/ products) to the customers


 ͏

  a. Periodic cadence with delivery team to:
 


* Provide them with customer feedback/ inputs on the proposed solution
* Review the test cases to check 100% coverage of customer requirements
* Conduct root cause analysis to understand the proposed solution/ demo/ prototype before sharing it with the customer
* Deploy and facilitate new change requests to cater to customer needs and requirements
* Support QA team with periodic testing to ensure solutions meet the needs of businesses by giving timely inputs/feedback
* Conduct Integration Testing and User Acceptance demoÃ¢Â€Â™s testing to validate implemented solutions and ensure 100% success rate
* Use data modelling practices to analyze the findings and design, develop improvements and changes
* Ensure 100% utilization by studying systems capabilities and understanding business specifications
* Stitch the entire response/ solution proposed to the RFP/ RFI before its presented to the customer

* Define and plan project milestones, phases and different elements involved in the project along with the principal consultant
* Drive and challenge the presumptions of delivery teams on how will they successfully execute their plans
* Ensure Customer Satisfaction through quality deliverable on time


 ͏

* Engage and interact with other BAÃ¢Â€Â™s to share expertise and increase domain knowledge across the vertical
* Write whitepapers/ research papers, point of views and share with the consulting community at large
* Identify and create used cases for a different project/ account that can be brought at Wipro level for business enhancements
* Conduct market research for content and development to provide latest inputs into the projects thereby ensuring customer delight

title: Junior Frontend Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**About Plane**
 Plane is an incisive response to config\-heavy, opinionated, and restrictive project management software. Check out our website.
   

  

 In just two years, Plane’s grown to \#1 in its category on GitHub and become a viable open\-core alternative to Jira, Monday, Wrike, Asana, ClickUp, and Linear, not to mention all\-in\-one tools like Notion or Obsidian.
   

  

 Our growth has come on the back of the product’s true flexibility without artificial limits, simple configurations that work out of the box, and thoughtfully packaged features that nurture our customers’ growth instead of punishing it.
   

  

 As a modern product start\-up, we obsess over new and power users equally. Our mission is to empower teams everywhere with the simplest, most delightful work management experience on the planet. Our vision is to become the WorkOS of the future with a workbench of unified tools and techniques that intuitively and progressively form a greater whole for knowledge workers.
   

  

 We’re well capitalized, backed by OSS Capital, and are revenue\-positive. Our coworkers include ex\-Microsoft, Deloitte, \[24]7, Nutanix, and Yahoo! in our 50\+ strong human force today.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Were looking for a Junior Frontend Engineer who is early in their career but already shows real hunger for the craft of building software. This is a role for someone who wants to work on a product that thousands of teams rely on, learn from engineers who care deeply about quality, and grow quickly by taking on meaningful, well\-scoped problems.
   

  

 You wont just be picking up tickets. Youll contribute to real user\-facing features, pair with senior engineers on harder problems, and steadily take on more ownership as you grow. Our expectation is that within a year, youll be shipping features end\-to\-end with confidence.
   

  

 Youll work directly with designers, product managers, and other engineers in a tight feedback loop, and your work will reach hundreds of thousands of users and thousands of teams globally.
   

  

**What Youll Do**
* Build user\-facing features. Implement user\-facing features across our product, contributing to UI components, data models, and API integrations. Youll start with well\-scoped work and gradually take on larger, more ambitious surfaces as you grow.
* Contribute to our sync and real\-time collaboration layer. Work alongside senior engineers to help extend our data synchronization mechanism and collaborative editing tools, which use a local\-first architecture. Youll learn how modern sync engines, serialization, and conflict resolution actually work in production.
* Learn and apply browser\-level performance techniques. Get hands\-on with Service Workers and IndexedDB for caching, and contribute to making Plane feel fast on slow networks and functional when users are offline.
* Help push UI performance. Profile and optimize rendering paths — virtualization, memoization, selective re\-renders — guided by senior engineers and our performance goals. Complex, dense views are a core part of Plane, and keeping them smooth is a shared responsibility.
* Add instrumentation to what you ship. Help build out analytics, monitoring, and alerting around new features so the team can spot issues early. Youll learn to think about observability as part of shipping, not as an afterthought.
* Work with our TypeScript tooling and build pipeline. Get comfortable with Vite and Rolldown, and contribute to keeping our developer experience fast and our production bundles lean.
* Participate in our open\-source work. Plane is open\-source at its core. Youll contribute patches, review community PRs, and help us maintain a healthy public codebase.
* Grow into strong engineering habits. Write clear code, ask good questions in reviews, document your work, and adopt the testing and review practices of a senior engineering team from day one.


**What Youll Bring**
* 2–4 years of professional frontend experience, with a portfolio of work (production apps, side projects, or open\-source contributions) that shows you can ship real software.
* Solid working knowledge of TypeScript and React. Youre comfortable with modern React — hooks, component composition, context — and you write TypeScript with intent rather than just appeasing the compiler.
* Working understanding of routing and state management. Practical experience with React Router and at least one client\-side state management library (MobX, Redux, Zustand, or similar). You should be able to reason about when state belongs local vs. global and how reactivity flows through your app.
* Comfort writing modern CSS. You can build responsive, themeable UIs and are comfortable with utility\-first CSS (Tailwind) or a similar modern approach.
* Good instincts for design and UI details. You dont have to be a designer, but you should notice when something feels off — a misaligned element, a clumsy empty state, a jarring transition — and care enough to fix it.
* A curious, prototyping mindset. Youre the kind of engineer whod rather build a small, working version of an idea than argue about it in the abstract.
* Comfort working in a small, fast\-moving team. You can take ownership of a task, ask good clarifying questions, and drive it to completion without needing constant direction.
* Attention to detail and a craft mindset. You care about the small things — the empty states, the loading behavior, the micro\-interactions — because they add up to how the product feels.
* A learners attitude. Youre eager to pick up new tools, unafraid to ask questions, and open to feedback in code review and beyond.


**Nice to Have**
* Contributions to open\-source projects, even small ones.
* Exposure to rich\-text editor frameworks (ProseMirror, CodeMirror, Lexical, Tiptap).
* Familiarity with Service Workers, IndexedDB, or offline\-first app patterns.
* Experience with Electron or desktop app packaging.
* Prior experience on project management, productivity, or collaboration products.


**Our Tech Stack**
**Frontend**
* React with TailwindCSS, using hooks for composable functionality
* React Router for client\-side routing
* MobX for binding the data model to the UI
* ProseMirror\-based content editor
* Electron for the desktop application


**Backend \& Infrastructure**
* Django/Python, Golang, and Elixir services


**PostgreSQL** 
 and
 **Redis**
* Public REST and GraphQL APIs with full access to user data
* AWS Cloud with Kubernetes and Rancher

title: HR Operations & Payroll Manager
description:
**About BrightCHAMPS** 




  





 BrightCHAMPS is a fast\-growing global edtech platform valued at $650M, delivering live, expert\-led learning in Coding, Robotics, Financial Literacy, Math, AI, and Communication to kids aged 6–16 across 30\+ countries and 12\+ languages. As we scale rapidly across geographies, we are building robust people operations infrastructure to support our growing workforce — and we're looking for seasoned HR leaders who can bring structure, rigour, and scale to our people operations.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a highly experienced and process\-driven
 **HR Operations \& Payroll Manager** 
 to own and strengthen our end\-to\-end HR operations, payroll processing, and statutory compliance functions. This is a senior leadership role for someone who has built and managed large\-scale HR operations, navigated complex compliance landscapes across geographies, and driven meaningful process transformation. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise across payroll systems, global compliance, HR analytics, and team leadership — and has a strong track record of managing HR operations for large, multi\-location workforces.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Payroll \& Statutory Compliance** 



* Own end\-to\-end payroll processing for 1500\+ employees across locations, ensuring 100% accuracy, timeliness, and statutory adherence
* Manage all statutory compliance obligations — PF, ESI, PT, LWF, TDS, Form 16, and IT Declarations — in close coordination with the global compliance team
* Oversee Full \& Final (F\&F) settlements, ensuring prompt processing in line with company policy and applicable labour laws
* Lead statutory audits, filings, and reconciliations; serve as the primary interface for internal and external auditors

* Review and validate payroll calculations received from external payroll consultants.



  





**HR Operations \& Systems** 



* Manage, configure, and continuously optimize HRIS and payroll platforms — Zoho Payroll, Keka, and DarwinBox — ensuring data integrity and system efficiency
* Lead full\-cycle payroll system implementations, including planning, data migration, validation, UAT, and go\-live
* Maintain rigorous headcount reconciliation across departments, cost centres, locations, and business units
* Oversee structured onboarding workflows ensuring a compliant, consistent, and positive experience for all new joiners
* Draft, review, and periodically update HR policies in alignment with business needs, legal frameworks, and best practices



  





**MIS, Analytics \& Budgeting** 



* Design and publish MIS reports and payroll analytics dashboards for HR leadership, finance, and business heads
* Manage HR budgets, headcount cost tracking, and payroll variance analysis; proactively flag risks and drive cost control
* Build and automate reporting frameworks using Advanced Excel and HRIS tools to improve accuracy and reduce manual effort
* Deliver data\-driven insights on workforce trends, attrition, and cost movements to support strategic decision\-making



  





**Team Leadership \& Process Excellence** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop the HR operations team — setting clear goals, building capability, and driving high performance
* Identify and execute process improvement and automation initiatives across payroll, compliance, and HR operations
* Serve as the senior escalation point for employee queries related to payroll, benefits, compliance, and HR processes
* Foster a culture of accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* **10–15 years** 
 of progressive experience in HR operations and payroll management, with significant exposure to global compliance teams and multi\-geography workforces
* Demonstrated experience managing end\-to\-end payroll and HR operations for a workforce of 1500\+ employees
* Understanding of payroll cycles, payroll accounting entries, and statutory deductions.
* Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure, and Follows defined SOPs and guidelines with discipline.
* Understanding in Indian statutory compliance — PF, ESI, PT, LWF, TDS, Form 16, and Labour Law adherence
* Hands\-on, advanced proficiency with HRIS and payroll platforms —
 **Zoho Payroll, Keka, and DarwinBox** 
 — including system implementation and migration experience
* Expertise in F\&F settlement processing, onboarding design, and HR policy drafting and review
* Proficiency in Advanced Excel; demonstrated ability to build MIS frameworks and payroll analytics reports
* Proven leadership experience managing and developing HR operations teams
* Strong analytical mindset, high attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a high\-growth environment
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — comfortable engaging with finance, legal, and business leadership



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with multi\-country or international payroll processing
* Exposure to HR process automation tools and HRIS integrations
* Prior experience in a high\-growth startup, edtech, or technology\-driven organization
* Familiarity with budgeting tools and workforce cost modelling



  





**Why BrightCHAMPS** 



* Be part of a mission\-driven global company impacting millions of learners across 30\+ countries
* Senior, high\-ownership role with direct visibility to CHRO and business leadership
* Fast\-paced, collaborative culture with real scope to build, automate, and transform HR operations
* Competitive compensation, strong benefits, and a meaningful growth trajectory

 KKR is looking for a Global Benefits Analyst to support the day\-to\-day administration of our benefit plans across the US, EMEA and APAC. Based in Gurugram and reporting to the Head of EMEA/APAC Benefits in London, this role will focus primarily on global benefits invoicing, billing, eligibility management, reporting and audit support.

* Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail, particularly in financial reconciliation and data validation.

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting global or multi\-country benefits administration.
* Exposure to benefits billing, vendor invoice reconciliation, payroll deductions and eligibility file management.
* Experience working with HRIS systems such as Workday.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across regional and global teams.
* A proactive, solutions\-oriented mindset with a strong sense of accountability and ownership.
